У нас в самом дорогом номере этого отеля тек потолок!!! Жалобы и вызовы персонала ни к чему не привели. Нам предложили включить кондиционер и тогда вода испариться!!! При том, что у них центральное кондиционирование и сколько ни повышай температуру, будет дуть ледяной воздух!!! Дверь на балконе заклинивало дважды, если бы отдыхала одна, пришлось бы кричать с балкона, чтобы кто-нибудь открыл! В ресторане при нас у людей на стол упал светильник!!! Хорошо, что никого не убил! Напитки в ресторане проще не ждать, а подходить и наливать самостоятельно. Или ждать примерно полчаса, напоминая раз по десять, что вы еще ждете. Уборка номеров- отдельная история... Диваны в номере настолько старые, что на них неприятно садиться. Это кстати касается всей мебели в отеле, все в пятнах, старое и крайне изношенное. Мусор возле лежаков не убирается, весь отпуск(10 дней) я наблюдала один и тот же стаканчик, лежащий между лежаками.Детский клуб больше похож на комнату временного пребывания малышей, когда родителям ну очень нужно оставить ребенка, по другой причине там ребенка не оставишь.Их там кстати и не было, когда пришли посмотреть. В целом после отпуска в этом отеле одно желание: приехать домой, отмыться, перестирать все и вспомнить наконец-то, что такое чистые полы, мебель и посуда!!!

reviews.author: Rachael Trotta
reviews.title: Company Presidents club trip
reviews.text:
I just spent the last 4 days at the Paradisus Palm Real Hotel in Punta Cana D.R. I was with a large group ( my husbands presidents club- 45 people) and everyone had the same complaints.  
Let me also preface that we had the basic package. I know that there were upgraded royal service etc.  so I’m sure not everyone who stays there has the same service and experience. Although the president of the company we were with stayed at the royal service and had many complaints as well. 
So... First off the drinks (even the wine) were watered down.  They refused to give us straws. The royal service got the paper straws. It was weird.  
The food was terrible. And the restaurants were just about impossible to get a reservation in at a decent time. They were very small and couldn’t accommodate the amount of people that stay at the resort. I guess they want people to go to the buffet. There is no food at the pool... only at the buffet. 
The service was terrible as well.  The wait staff at the buffet & in the restaurants were slow, rude ... just horrible. 
However I will say the service on the beach was great!   The beach was the best part... there were many lounge chairs with the hut umbrellas which was great. We would go down early to reserve a spot large enough for part of our group otherwise we would never get to be together because they fill up fast. 

Everything closes at 11:00 except for at the casino so that was a bummer. 
The rooms... they were fine.  We had a bad view of the road but there only seems to be a handful of rooms that actually have sea views.  It seems that most of the rooms have a garden view (better than ours).  There is a huge tub and a shower. The shower most complained  that they were too short (I’m short so I had no problem lol.) and very difficult to get the temperature right.
The toilet room and shower both had half doors and they were glass with boxes of frosted glass. It was very strange. Not much privacy. 
The resort is very large and pretty. The spa I couldn’t get a massage so I don’t know how that was. 
We’ve been on this trip with the large group to many different islands and I have to say that this was by far the worst hotel / resort we’ve stayed at.

reviews.author: Tourist22966973874
reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN!
reviews.text: Way overpriced for an aging resort with outdated rooms and a staff that could care less about their guests.  We were fortunate that our company paid for our trip as an award, but I would never recommend anyone pay to stay at this place.  Food was average, service terrible and rooms need an update.  No where near the quality of resorts in Hawaii or even Cancun.

reviews.author: SOC
reviews.title: Not a 5 Star Experience...Maybe a 2 or 3 with your own effort...
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that I am only now writing a review after reaching out to different levels of management since the start of our stay on April 1st.  To date, I have received no response, which is indicative of the true disregard for you as a costumer.  

I can confidently say that I have never had such a disappointing vacation, given the stress on myself, my husband, my father, and daughter in managing the variety of issues we encountered during our stay.  First, in calling Meliá to make my reservation, I found a non-working reservation system and was encouraged to book online myself.  I attempted to clarify several times as to how to best identify the beach front family concierge experience I was seeking and was directed to book the Reserve Punta Cana- please don’t do this!  What a mistake!  I spent about 14 emails (48-hr response return) later and phone calls (PS there is no direct number to speak with someone- wrap your head around this). Attempting to make sense of the reviews I read about the different sections of the hotel to discover that I had needed to book the Palm Real reserve...confused yet?  Of course, this is intentional.  When a hotel is only partially renovated, they benefit from this confusion.  Having you pay top rate for a subpar, rundown room.  While I was finally responded to and moved to the Palma Real allegedly, I noted that the online program did not reflect this and was assured via email by Jason Espiritusanto, who suggested this would be corrected upon arrival. Our transportation service dropped us off at the Reserve as I understood that our concierge was here... Upon checking in, we encountered Harol, a very difficult guest service representative.  I attempted to show him my correspondence and asked several times about the correspondence I had had to this end.  He assured me I was in the right place- but we were not!  I even showed him on the Meliá app and said, why is this not reflecting the palma real...he said it would update.  This was duplicitous of course.  The charge for our room was increased to reflect the Palma Real and we proceeded to be guided to our room at the Punta Cana Reserve.  The swim up suite was Run down, broken rooms, swampy pools loaded with bugs and leaves, and room service that makes McDonald’s looks luxurious.  I had spent a considerable amount of time doing this research and was shocked as to how these other reviews did not indicate issues such as these... How could the gross manipulation, deliberate misguidance and overt dismissals not be represented in these reviews... I came to understand how this happens...

While my husband and I have a little facility with the Spanish language, my father who joined us in fluent.  Here’s what I have come to understand, staff are responsible for soliciting their own referrals for their job security and promotions.  We were asked and told several times about the way this works, and pleaded with to do our best to reflect well on them or their jobs could be in jeopardy... yes, rather than formal internal job training and reviews, employees are subjected to public reviews for job security and promotions?  Completely outrageous!  As you spend your vacation attempting to relax, you are met with a hotel that you have spent thousands on whose employees are anxious and working under the threat of TripAdvisor feedback that could directly impact their jobs... I generally choose to spend my money at establishments where I can be sure employees are well treated and respected.  And so, how do your manage this tension, while attempting to salvage your experience of a promised five star experience, you tip constantly.  Some days to the tune of $75-125 USD in order to get the service you would expect at a space like this.  If you do not prepare to have this cash in advance, expect to pay a 20% fee for the exchange at the hotel.  The ATM’s have a $200 USD limit and only hands out equivalent of $20 bills that no one breaks...hmmmm... and so, here’s a quick rundown of expectations and upsets that may help you navigate if you find yourself stuck with a prepaid reservation as we did. 

Rooms: Run Down, room cleaning service does not clean rooms adequately- sheets and bedding with dried blood, hair in drains, broken glass shelf precariously hanging over the tub we bathe our child in, broken lamps with incompatible outlets for the room- cue no lights!   Luckily, I was the only one who ended up stepping on Glass fragments and not my daughter. Fellow patrons may drunkenly throw their trash over their patio, onto yours soiling your jacuzzi and seating area.  This may not ever sufficiently be cleaned, in spite of reporting, and you will not feel comfortable using this area during your stay.  And lastly, During your time here, you will find yourself without sufficient towels and water...be prepared to call regular for these things with tip in hand. 

Spa: skip it!  Not luxurious...masseuses do not seem to have sufficient training, and the spa Does not have A/C!  I also was greeted to my massage with an up-sale and those resort credits don’t exist.  They work nowhere and only allow you the privilege of buying from this place...or offer a faux discount that the spa will tell you, they can beat.  They don’t give you these resort coupons as you need to hand deliver them after searching them out (don’t bother they are useless).  But this runaround is comical.  The spa will up sell you and are unrelenting.  I was escorted out from my massage by a woman who later appeared with a calculator offering me a discounted next massage which is outrageous, and not relaxing.  There is no relaxation room and so I sat adjacent to the landscaping crew with my hot tea served from a dirty dispenser...I left immediately after being disappointed.  

Family Concierge:  I am not sure how folks navigate the resort without these folks. Although let me say, they serve more as counselors and facilitators and have no real power to help You troubleshoot your encounters.  We were initially assigned Jorge Tejada, who was wonderful, and later Willy Wonka, who was also fantastic.  They help you to get dinner reservations that seem in high demand...only the restaurants seem empty usually...and filled with other patrons lamenting the poor quality of the food.

Food:  lower your expectations and bring tums...
Low quality food, over cooked meals that lack fresh ingredients and are over salted.  Fresh fruit and vegetables are scarce... we survived off the breakfast Buffett at the main resort... do not eat breakfast at the Reserve unless you are unworried about warm dairy sitting out, over cooked and aged sides...truly stomach turning.  Omelette station is the thing that allowed us to approximate fresh and recently cooked ingredients... Our collective stomach upset continues to settle a week later.

Pool: reserve pool is usually quiet, minus unannounced foam party during our stay with children in the pool... staffed by wonderful folks including Felipe and Jorge.  They made our experience by helping us poolside, and we needed for nothing as a result. Problem is outside vendors are Constant...selling will preoccupy your stay.

Beach: seaweed collection...beautiful sand and palm trees... constant vendors that are sales pressured and will interrupt you constantly.  Far less relaxing than you would hope.

Customer service: unresponsive and unhelpful.  The worst of these experience was with Harol, guest service representative.  Our fellow patrons who witnessed his behavior and his aggression with us, shared their concerns and outrage about his behavior and the ways in which they too imagined nothing would happen given the poor customer service.

In the end, we will Not be back.  For the record, I have reached out to the following managers via email: Gabriel Bobadilla, Rafael Torres Sanchez, Carlos Silva Junior, and Jose Carlos Sanchez, and have received no response.  We overpaid and we were taken advantage of.  Please do consider traveling elsewhere.  We loved the Ritz Carlton in Aruba and would suggest this as a family-friendly tropical alternative.

reviews.author: Kik54
reviews.title: Tracasseries administratives grotesques
reviews.text:
C’est la sixième année consécutive que nous réservons à cet endroit, c’est dire s’il nous plait ! Par contre cette année le début du séjour a commencé de façon plus que décevante, grotesque même !
En effet nous sommes arrivés en début d’après-midi à l’hôtel, et nous pensions pouvoir déjà profiter de notre première 1/2 journée sur place, c’était sans compter les tracasseries administratives qui nous attendaient : je dois vous préciser que depuis le temps, nous sommes pour Meliá des clients « Gold » , j’effectue mon check-in en ligne depuis chez moi avant d’arriver, et j’effectue ma réservation plusieurs mois à l’avance en appelant la centrale téléphonique Meliá située en Espagne après avoir consulté le site Internet Melià, et comme à la fin de la conversation téléphonique je dois faire une réservation ferme et définitive en réglant l’intégralité du séjour de suite, j’utilise, pour des raisons de sécurité bancaire, une payweb card.
Je vais ici préciser ce qu’est une payweb card puisque c’est ce qui m’a valu toutes les difficultés qui ont suivies et que je pensais que ce système était connu dans le monde entier, je m’excuse donc auprès de ceux qui connaissent le principe, car mes explications vont leur paraître superflues.
Pour effectuer un paiement sécurisé sur Internet ou, comme dans mon cas, par téléphone, je fais une demande auprès de ma banque qui me donne un numéro virtuel unique à 16 chiffres attaché à ma carte bancaire, lequel numéro ne peut être utilisé qu’une seule fois et pour un montant bien précis.
Notre séjour en All Inclusive était donc réservé et intégralement payé au mois de novembre 2018 alors que notre séjour commençait en mars 2019.
À notre arrivée à la réception de l’hôtel, on nous a demandé de produire la carte bleue avec le numéro qui m’avait servi au règlement, ce qui forcément était impossible pour nous puisque ce numéro n’était que virtuel et que je ne pouvais produire que ma véritable carte bleue, celle à laquelle avait été attaché le numéro virtuel.
Nous leur avons expliqué en long, en large et en travers et finalement en vain, la procédure utilisée et proposé de prendre l’empreinte de la carte que j’avais en ma possession pour le cas où on ferait des extras pendant notre séjour : rien n’y faisait, ils s’obstinaient à vouloir qu’on leur produise une carte bleue qui n’existait pas et ne voulaient absolument pas nous donner nos clés de chambre, ce qui pour nous était une aberration car nous avions réglé d’avance notre séjour en All Inclusive, et nous avions droit à nos clés de chambre, car à ce moment-là c’était plutôt l’hôtel qui était redevable envers nous d’une prestation réglée d’avance que nous envers lui d’une somme d’argent !
Nous avons eu plusieurs interlocuteurs face à nous car toutes ces palabres ont duré plus de 3 heures ! Finalement nous nous sommes engagés à entrer en contact avec notre banque, pour que celle-ci fasse un mail à l’hôtel assurant que la carte bleue en notre possession n’était pas volée et était bien provisionnée. Avec le décalage horaire, ce n’est que le lendemain dans le courant de l’après-midi que notre banque a pu faire l’envoi du fameux mail, qui finalement a dû satisfaire la direction de mélia, car nous n’avons plus eu de nouvelles pendant tout le séjour ! Finalement pour nous les vacances n’ont commencé qu’au bout d’une journée et demie, ce qui est relativement dommage, qui plus est que l’on ne nous a rien proposé,à titre de geste purement commercial, pour nous faire oublier toutes ces tracasseries inutiles !!!
J'ai voulu partager cette expérience car je pense qu'elle pourrait arriver à d'autres. A noter que si ça ne change pas, même les personnes qui auraient réservé avec une carte bleue arrivée à échéance entre le moment de la réservation et du séjour connaîtrait les mêmes déboires que nous !

reviews.author: Katiuska2013
reviews.title: What a shame!
reviews.text:
I visited this resort a few years ago and I had such a good time that I decided to return. It has completely changed and I don't mean when it comes to the additional buildings like the Reserve or the level but as far as the service and entertainment is concerned.

Pros: Building and rooms are beautiful and clean. Employees at the Bar Gabi Beach and Avenue are great when it comes to preparing drinks.

Cons: The buffet is terrible. Food is either cold like it has been sitting there for a long time or warmed up from the day before. It's pretty much the same thing every day but arranged differently! The only thing that seems fresh is the eggs that are made to order in the morning or the chicken or steak from the grilling station.  Staff does not help you find a table. Depending on how busy they are, they don't bring you water or drinks to your table unless you call them. No mimosas offered when you check in or at breakfast which was something they used to do the first time I came. The music that is played either at the bar or the restaurant is to put you to sleep. There is no back up plan for entertainment on rainy days. There is only one bar that plays Salsa, Merengue, Bachata (Avenue Bar) and the music is lowered or in some cases stops after 11:00pm. The shows offered at night are boring or there isn't any offered at all. The disco closes at 1:00am. The girls at the reception desk are rude, the people at the guest service practically ignore you even after standing there for at least 10 minutes. The app they tell you to use to find out the activities for the day or make restaurant reservations doesn't work and I went to the reception desk to let them know and instead they just said here is a printout of the week activities which led me to believe they already knew it wasn't working then why didn't they give me the list at check in?
In summary, if you want to go to sleep early or just sit, eat and drink all day this is your place to be. If not, stay away. I know for sure I won't be coming back.

reviews.author: 482Maribel
reviews.title: Experiencia en Palma Real Resort
reviews.text: El pasado 21 de marzo de2019. Estuve por primera vez en el Resort Palma Real e Punta Cana. Perteneces a Melia Reward. Quiero agradecer a la Joven Ángela de Royal Service. Por su atención cuando llegue y las veces q hablé con ella antes de mi llegada. . Tambien hiero agradecer a mi mayordomo Alvaro Fernandez por excelente atencion. También Elbin Contanzo quien me atendió en todo momento en la playa donde pasaba casi todo el dia. Se esmeró en su atención.  Richard Rosari, Supervisor de Room Service. Que nos conocimos el último día pero su atención y servicio hacia mi fue excelente. Desde el 2016 visitaba siempre Royal Service de Parradissus Punta Cana. Este año quise probar Palma Real. En verdad q me decepcione. Tienen que mejorar mucho en la calidad ,variedad y cantidad de la comidad. Las veces q visite el buffet no compara con Paradissus. Falta de personal , readiestral al personal. Llegar a una mesa y ver que le pasamos por el lado y no atender a uno. En el desayuno una mesa sin azúcar. Cubiertos , sal ni pimienta. Tuve q decirle a la mesera q me trajera todo esto. En cuanto uno llega deben venir a ofrecerle café h jugo. Yo tenía q llamar a la meder. Un día en  el almuerzo en el restaurante d Royal Service me quede esperando un vaso de hielo q nunca llego. Debe haber supervisores en los restaurantes verificando cómo se está llevando el servicio. Presencia de moscas sobre los alimentos , Eso no puede pasar, La amabilidad de los empleados tanto de servicio como de oficinas al pasarle a uno por el lado debe de mejorar. Estuve en en esa isla caribeña. Donde se distribuye por su música. No quiero escuchar música en inglés por un DJ. Quiero merengue , bachata, salsa. Presencia de un grupo todas las noches. En el Lobby. El americano, europeo les encanta esa música latina como a nosotros.  Música americana de más hay en la discoteca. Pensé que sería superior  a Parradissus pero no. Sigo visitando Parradissus PUnta Cana. El ambiente , atención , calidad , familiaridad, servicio es superior.

reviews.author: SFox-Levine
reviews.title: Second class citizens
reviews.text:
We are avid cruisers on Royal Caribbean and Celebrity but wanted to try something different. Cruising has spoiled us apparently since nothing could compare at The Reserve. We had read on TripAdvisor that it did not matter if we stayed in the Family concierge so we booked a regular suite. 

5 star is really what we would consider 3 star in the US for food and service. The facilties and room would be a 4. The sofa bed my 13 year old slept on was so uncomfortable that he had to put the cushions from the couch on it. The buffets were average. I’ve been accustomed to buffets having food allergies identified since I have a gluten allergy but here they were not. Vento in The Reserve was just bad. The other restaurants we went to were better but the effort to get the reservations was not worth the quality of the food. The Family Concierge rooms had all the dinner times 7-9. We had to wait each day until 5p to beg the concierge for one of these times. The evening ‘shows’ were awful;however, the DJ was awesome on the beach at night! The chairs on the pool deck were all reserved with a towel by 8a. Again, Family concierge had the first two rows reserved but we were happy third row back by the bar. The beach was amazing so we spent our four days there. We were able to take our time in the morning and still get 3 chairs at 10a. The drinks were good so this helped make up for the frustrations! All in all, we felt like we were treated like second class citizens and realized we should have stayed Family Concierge instead.

reviews.author: Nishi d
reviews.title: Highly discrimination between family concierge and normal booking. Worst place to go
reviews.text:
We have been to many all inclusive resorts. This is the worst experience, not worth your time and money. All buffets in the resort servers recycle food. Suffered from stomach bug while our stay.Unfortunately it rained when we were there and most of shuttle drivers were not considerate to pick and drop us( with kids and strollers) to shaded area. However Beach is nice and clean. One thing I really hated so much separation between level of services. You will get reservations after 9 for restaurants,all fronts and 2nd rows of cabanas at beach and swimming pool side will be blocked for family concierge, Different buffet menu. Felt so ignored. I was so disappointed even though we booked master suite paid extra for pool view. I wish we knew about family concierge category. If you are planning then please don’t go for normal booking. 
Pros. Nice beach
Not overly crowded
Nice people at kids zone

Cons
Too much of discrimination between regular and family concierge package, felt ignored.. won’t recommend regular package.
Bad bad food
Not many options for kids food
Small bed 
Sofa bed is not comfortable 
Beach servers are not very friendly
Rooms are old

reviews.author: happinessafar
reviews.title: Disappointing visit
reviews.text:
To be fair, I should say that we stayed here about five years ago and had such an amazing experience that the kids really wanted to go back. I have raved to people with kids since than that the Reserve is a place you AND the kids can feel like you both had a vacation. Unfortunately, things have changed since our last visit. We had a Family Concierge Master Suite and a Paradisus Suite. We traveled with our kids and an au pair the beginning of March. 

The Pros: The beach is great. It's clean, there are always chairs and the service was friendly and prompt. The grounds are well kept and compared to the other resorts on their property we really enjoyed all the trees and cabanas/chairs. There's shade and privacy. We were given bracelets to use the Grand pool and children's club and while the service was great there is no shade. 

The Cons: It seems nothing has been upgraded or kept up in the last five years. The lights in our master bedroom couldn't be turned off with a switch. According to our concierge we could only turn them off and on by plugging and unplugging them. The couch and curtains had stains on them. There was an opened and half-drank bottle of Perrier in our mini-fridge when we arrived.  We did not have hot water in our shower for 2 1/2 days. Maintenance came multiple times to fix it, but it only worked if you ran the tub water. Our concierge's solution was to schedule the time we wanted to take showers and she would come run our tub water so our shower would be hot. I said that wasn't really an acceptable solution when infants were trying to sleep so maintenance came again and they "opened it up" so we would have hot water right away. Not sure why that took 2 1/2 days. The mini bar was only restocked occasionally, not every day. The coffee was finally refilled after I had to complain.  We only had turn down service 2 nights. Our TV in the living room never worked. The first night we were there the sofa bed was not pulled out and made, even though we had made them aware that we needed it for my son. Finally someone came at 10 pm. The pool is pretty cold and it was rather dirty. I did see them cleaning it every morning though. While at the spa I went to use the water ritual circuit and the hot tubs were murky and cold. The rock water feature didn't work. While at spinning some of the other guests were complaining of similar issues. Service was hit and miss. My husband and kids were sick for about a week after we returned. 

Usually, I'll just go along with things and make the best of an experience. This isn't a Four Seasons or St. Regis and that wasn't what we were expecting; however, this trip was so far off from our last experience I had to take my issues to the manager. We won't be going back to a Melia hotel....or the Dominican.

reviews.author: Leigh C
reviews.title: Go somewhere else
reviews.text: The property is gorgeous and the rooms are gorgeous but the food was bad enough that i dropped 5 lbs and we moved to another resort. The food was served cold and wet at times. We werent even sure if we were served the right meat at the steakhouse...

reviews.author: Josephine K
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds but if you plan on starving this is the place to be!
reviews.text: The reviews here are honest EXCEPT for the food. Horrible limited options and the food is always stale. No flavor and the chefs don’t know how to cook here. We are on the 4th day and still in shock with the “buffet” options and lack of. We have been to 4 star hotels with exceptional food and larger options. Even going over to the shared standard section of the Punta Cana Resort and Spa is bland and disappointing. The bathrooms are subpar for a master suite. They need to up their game and quality of food. The customer service and people are moody and rude. They don’t know how to be friendly and it looks fake and painful when they try. The grounds are beautiful thanks to nature! I would suggest this place if you want to overspend and feel like you’re in a “reserve” special spot but on a fasting diet!

reviews.author: Cdmhiggins
reviews.title: Spring weekend
reviews.text: Very dissapointed.  Upgraded to the Royal to be closer to beach/pools.  The room was below average for an upgrade. The toilet paper dispenser was broken, there were Gross markings on the bathroom stall, the patio door did not lock and the entrance door had a cut in it so you could see to the outside.  The food was not desirable.  Bana Steak was sooo  tough.  We upgraded for concierege service.  The only times we saw our dedicated butler was when we checked in he showed us around, showed us where to make dinner reservations and tried to get us to see the time shares.  That was the first day.  All other reservations we made ourselves.  Next time we saw him was when we checked out.  There was a huge language barrier.  I would not consirder this a 5 star hotel

reviews.author: Sherpa55818462686
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Super disappointed this time around. Nothing seemed to work in the rooms. Dinner reservations that we thought had been made, weren’t. The whole week we felt like we were being ignored.  This was our third time here - I doubt we will be back.

reviews.author: TerriRice
reviews.title: Will Not Go Back!
reviews.text:
Although the rooms and views are beautiful, this hotel does not live up to the promises. Safety is a huge issue and concern! We took our 18 year old boys for Spring Break. One boy was mugged, robbed, and left naked in a stairwell the first night. Funny how they claim to have cameras throughout the resort, but for some reason could not find him on any feed. I asked the hotel to comp or discount the room for this family who spent most of their time dealing with security and filing police reports. The rooms manager said to me "why should we do that"? We had another of our young guys "jumped" on the beach and beaten. We had two credit cards stolen and another compromised. We understand it was Spring Break and things were pretty crazy... but the hotel's security team was not prepared.  

We were also told each room would be given 1000 credits to use for services. These credits were not the same as other resorts. We were given a COUPON BOOK for DISCOUNTS. For example spend $50 in wine and get $10 off, spa treatments... the spa itself gave a 20% discount which was more than the coupon. The coupons for the store were only for specific brands of clothing...etc. Therefore, most of the coupon books went unused. 

Golf WAS NOT included although it says it is on their website and what we were told at check in. We again had COUPONS for free green fees, we were meant to pay for clubs and the cart only. The shop girl said our coupons could not be used and charged us $145 pp (discount of $40). I have asked for a refund for all our players, but no word from the hotel.

The food was marginal, the drinks watered down and most of the staff unfriendly.

The butlers in the Royal Service were the only saving grace of this stay. They went above and beyond to take care of us. Nicolas, Avaro, and Jery were great. Rafeal at the pool bar was also a big help. 

Would not recommend this resort and will not return.

reviews.author: ChiTravel84
reviews.title: Would Not Return
reviews.text:
I was really excited to stay here. However, the stay was not worth it. We decided to book Royal Service and it was extremely expensive but thought it was worth it at the time. We were wrong. Our butler was non-existent, checked in with us at most once a day if even checked in at all, and didn't provide any extra benefit than you get at the regular portion of the hotel. I'm not sure what Royal Service provides that everyone else doesn't receive anyway since we didn't get any special treatment except a "private checkin/checkout" area.

We didn't have towels multiple days after housekeeping came through, didn't have snacks replenished in the room, didn't have soap or lotion after we ran out mid stay, and didn't have any bottles of water at one point. The housekeeping itself was lacking attention to detail on the most basic things like towels and amenities. However, they were eager to take our tips we left them each day regardless of the quality of work they provided.

The Royal Service beach service was also missing. If we were lucky we'd get one of the guys to come over every couple of hours. We ended up going to the pool bar instead to get drinks and bringing them back since there was really no beach service the entire week. Generally, the staff is not friendly and we were beyond nice and courteous the entire time regardless of the fact that we were not happy with what we ended up getting out of this vacation.

The steakhouse restaurant is bad. Do not eat there. The quality of food is horrendous and will leave you hungry and visiting the buffet afterwards. The buffet was okay, nothing special but did have a variety of options. However, the choices don't change and it was pretty much the same food each day for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Even the alcohol and liquor choices were very low quality. The wine was terrible, the vodka was low grade, and there was no consistency on the quality of drinks.

The beach is loaded with panhandlers and will walk through the resort beach area to solicit. It got very annoying after the first few times. It happens all throughout the day so you eventually just learn to ignore them and hope they move on to someone else. Even walking from your beach chair to the water they will hunt you down to talk to you about buying something or an excursion. 

If you book directly through hotel you should receive private transfers to and from the airport. While that was nice, it was a very long wait time. After we found the booth at the airport upon arrival (Otium transportation), we waited in their shuttle van for over 45 minutes while they waited for more arrivals. Ridiculous! Same on the return from the hotel to the airport. It took well over an hour as you stop at other Melia properties on the way. Save yourself the headache and just get a taxi.

The positives include: The Hibachi restaurant, the pools (although very cold and not heated), the sandy beach, the property grounds, and the rooms were decent.

reviews.author: neila leal
reviews.title: Praia de Bávaro - Muito Sargaço
reviews.text:
A praia é cheia de sargaço. Não acredito que seja temporada.
Fiquei decepcionada. Se gosta de tomar banho de mar (como eu), leve isso em consideração. O mar é verdinho, de fato, mas não é transparente porque a areia é muito fina e fica em estado de suspensão. Talvez em passeios de barco as coisas sejam diferentes. Mas passeio de barco não é minha "praia".

reviews.author: Rijanka
reviews.title: very dissapointing
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for 4 days at the end of February 2019.
Even though it is a beautiful property, the service there is almost non-existent, very scarce ...you really start to feel unwelcomed. We traveled a lot throughout the Caribbean and the world and never encountered such a poor service at a so-called 5-star resort

reviews.author: Rhonda
reviews.title: Custumer Service lacking
reviews.text: Maid was attentive in keeping our room clean and turned down blankets in the eve. However, the customer service agents located in our building wasn’t helpful   We waiting over 20 minutes for shuttle service. Wished our room was closer to beach. The beach experience was great but could have done without the vendors walking up/down the beach

reviews.author: Daniela C
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: This is a beautiful and large resort. The rooms are large, the bathrooms are small, but have a large jacuzzi and shower. Being a all inclusive, what was very disappointing was the choices and quality of drinks, specially wine and the choices for lunch. The pool and beach do not serve any lunch and service is almost equal to zero. If you want a drink on the beach you better go and get it, no matter how much you tip the beach attendant. With the Royal Service I feel we spent a lot of money for nothing. I do not recommend this resort and we will not be back.

reviews.author: Amanda M
reviews.title: Un lugar hermoso sin embargo no volvería
reviews.text:
Mi experiencia.

Un lugar hermoso, higiénico de mas, espectacular  pero se quemaron en servicio

Fuimos un grupo de amigos y nuestra experiencia fue horrible en varios aspecto:
1) tienen los camareros y su personal que parecen máquinas cuando te reciben. Los empleados hay que direccionarlos pero hay que dejarlos ser (te reciben el restauran, saludos yo le estaba esperando. Dígame que  es un placer servirme, pero no que yo me de cuenta que usted tiene un esquema, los gerentes deben revisar que le dicen a sus colaboradores y la manera que lo entrenan.
2) En otro orden, escuché un gerente hablar de manera un poco denigrante de los dominicanos, si usted está trabajando en mi país lo menos que merece la tierra que le da la comida a usted y su familia es respeto, si tiene algo que decir o comentar, puede hacerlo en la intimidad de su oficina, no en un lugar publico de su hotel, porque una persona como yo le puede escuchar.
3) A la hora de salir en recepción te preguntan, cuándo llegaste? se supone que tienes un registro en tu computadora que te indica cuando llegué y que puedes cobrar y listo, no hacerme sentir que un lugar tan espectacular no saben trabajar.
4) En el caso de cuando avisas que vas a la playa y reservas el carrito, primero se llevan a todos, menos al que es dominicano, si su Hotel no está destinado al país en el cual están, entonces deben decirlo, para no pasar el mal gusto de ir y gastar mi dinero.
5) En los restaurante que son de reservas nos dejaron esperando mas de una hora para darnos el servicio, si no nos quejamos quizás estaríamos esperando aun.

reviews.author: Adventure55088125125
reviews.title: not coming back
reviews.text: not recommending the hotel. The location and beach is great... but the food was not good, also the bars at the pool and beach served the drinks in flimsy cheap paper cups....very disappointed, no comparison with other all inclusive...like Gan Velas in Mexico

reviews.author: GFBastian
reviews.title: No Electricity & no Hot water
reviews.text:
On February 10, 2019 our group of 10 people went to Paradisus-Palma-Real all inclusive resort in Punta Cana for our 7 day Tennis Vacation.  The Pool, Grounds, & Beach were wonderful as was the help.

To make our tennis vacation even more memorable we agreed to Upgrade.  What we got for our Upgrade was the electricity going offs on numerous occasions, a shower that malfunctioned and would not provide Hot water, & toilets that did not work.  In addition, when we made the reservations, we ask to have our rooms near each other.  Two of our party were in building #12 on the 1st floor, two were in building #38 on the 1st floor, & one was in building #38 on the 3rd floor. 

Did I mention that it was a Tennis Vacation?  The tennis courts were horrible & unplayable. 

They call it an All Inclusive Resort.  That is not true.  You had to pay extra to dine at two of their restaurants.  In fact, for Valentines Day they wanted to charge $240 per couple extra for dinner.

We selected the Melia Resort because we stayed at other Melia Resorts & was very pleased with our stay.

This resort is a beautiful resort but it appears that the infrastructure in not being maintained.
  
Needless to say, our group will never go to another Melia Resorts unless we are guaranteed that all these problems are solved.

reviews.author: FellowTraveler257924
reviews.title: Beautiful facility and employees with bad attitudes
reviews.text:
Summary: beautiful facility and events but multiple bad experiences with employees ruined the vacation. Mediocre food and facility is full of aggressive salespersons.

Facility: 5/5 beautiful facilities on the beach. Love the architecture and design. Great pool and beach setup. Daily electrical blackouts for ten to twenty minutes at a time but only during the day. 

Food: 3/5 complete hit or miss. The majority of the buffet food is quite horrible but has a good desert bar. Make sure to get your reservations in for the sit down restaurants - these were decent. No real dress code.

Employees: 1/5 multiple encounters over multiple days many rude employees and we did not cheap out on the tips. With each of the departments (front desk, bell boy, reservations, cleaning), there were employees that were rude and made you feel uncomfortable. Not looking for bad attitudes on a beach vacation... For example, bell boy took our luggage, lost an article of clothing, and attempted to blame us for losing it... Also picture this, you are sitting on a white sand beach sipping a mojito and enjoying the ocean views. Two minutes in, a salesperson comes. Another two minutes pass another one yells at you from afar. Repeat every day and every two minutes for multiple days... Do not get me wrong there were a handful of superb employees there too but the amount of bad experiences made it unruly.

reviews.author: SweetSheilaLyn
reviews.title: Buyers Beware...
reviews.text:
I am giving this resort a "2.5" out of "5." 

While check-in was timely, I felt the check-in process was very rushed. After having traveled a great number of hours before arriving, I was hoping that the welcome would be a bit more relaxed and personal and include a modicum of warmth. The person who handled my check-in basically talked as if she was reading a script for the 1 millionth time and she just wanted to get it over with. She hardly made eye contact and seemed to just want to cross us off her "to-do" list. It was very impersonal and very cold and did not make a good first impression of the place. Also, every time I was in the main lobby for whatever reason, there seemed to be a lot of unhappy customers trying to resolve various problems they were having with their rooms, etc.

Overall, I found the service at this resort to be very poor for the price. I pretty much had to BEG my concierge and the housekeeping department via phone multiple times to provide us with clean bath towels, hand towels, and wash cloths (they remained generally unresponsive despite all of our requests). I also had to beg for water and juice for the refrigerator in our room, which I thought would be stocked on some kind of regular basis (I was wrong). I didn't leave any tip for our concierge (Braian). He did almost nothing for us, and then the day before we were leaving, he suddenly expressed interest in whether or not we needed anything. He also showed up in the lobby area and hung around at the time he knew we would probably be checking out / departing. I think he was waiting for a tip. We did not give him anything. I wish we could have had Cristian assigned to us as our concierge. He was much more personable and helpful and kind. My traveling companion insisted we leave something for the housekeeping people, so we did. If I was on my own, I wouldn't have done so. There was an empty plastic water bottle on the floor of the patio upon our arrival. So I don't think they even looked on the patio, let alone ever cleaned it. We didn't pick the water bottle up. It is probably still there. We often saw glasses and cups and various pieces of cutlery and plates and garbage left all over the place on the resort, sometimes staying in the same place for hours or days. Either they are short-staffed or the staff just doesn't care.

The restaurants were alright. We only went to the ones that were included in the price of the resort. Mole (the Mexican restaurant) and Fuego (the Latin fusion restaurant) were the best in terms of food and service. We never made it to the Vento restaurant. I found the food at the Gabi Club buffet to be ok. They couldn't seem to get the temperature of the food right though. Things that should have been hot weren't. Service at the Gabi Club was extremely poor. We asked for the same things over and over 4 or 5 times at several meals, and still were either forgotten about / ignored. Staff at the Italian restaurant were rude. Staff at Gabi Beach seemed to want to hurry you out of there, even though the place is huge and there were tons of empty tables. Agua staff seemed very rude. Daniel Liven was the best server - he was working at Gabi Club and was very personable and responsive. He was the light in the darkness of that particular restaurant. I was hoping for some drinks to be delivered to me at the pool during our time there, but it was honestly easier to get up and walk a ways and get them yourself. Again, I do not know if the resort is understaffed or the staff just don't care or what the deal was, but I hardly ever saw a beverage delivery person at the pool area. Beverage service to your chair seemed to be better at the beach though.

Our best experience probably occurred at the YHI Spa. There were 3 people there that I found to be excellent at their jobs: Luz and Mercedes (massage therapists), and Joselina (a bilingual woman who worked at the reception desk in the spa). While the Spa area itself was small compared to others that I have frequented, the massages and facial I had were great. 

Be prepared to ride the trolleys a lot through out your stay if you plan on being in the Reserve area, which is a distance from the beach and almost all of the restaurants. We didn't mind, because we are not big beach people. But I could see some people getting frustrated with the amount of time they were spending waiting for trolleys and riding on trolleys at their vacation. 

The grounds are beautiful. There is a very very very strong odor of sewer near the spa area, which is very unfortunate. I felt bad for the people in the buildings in that area of the resort.

reviews.author: Susan M
reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Dirty rooms with multiple amenities not working. Power went out during the night before my friends wedding & everyone was forced to get ready in the dark with no water for hours. Manager was cold & unapologetic

reviews.author: Caryn H
reviews.title: Poor quality food and drink and we became sick.
reviews.text:
Theis hotel features lovely accommodations, nice pools, a beautiful beach, and  a very nice staff.
The problem is the food and drinks. Very poor quality liquor, much lower quality than RIU and Iberostar chains that I have visited previously.
I requested a room with 2 beds upon booking, but was assigned a king bed room upon checking in, so I had to wait until after 5pm to get a room, waiting in the lobby for almost 3 hours. I had to make 3 trips to the restaurant reservation station because the system was down.
The food preparation staff do not wear gloves. There is a problem with the filtered water and the ice in the bar drinks. My companion and I became very I'll after a few days at this resort and we learned that other guests also became sick ( stomach and intestinal symptoms). The hotel has a bad sewage type smell outside some of the buildings that are away from the beach area. 
I would not recommend this hotel to anyone

reviews.author: Fei S
reviews.title: not recommend to anyone
reviews.text: we spent over USD2500 for 3 nights, and communicated with hotel 3 weeks before our arrival regarding the arrival time, room request and special occasion( my son's birthday). Guess what we got? Wait for almost 4 hours to check in, first room is very noise as there is power generator outside run all day,change to the second room located on the third floor of very outdated villa which has no elevator (we have to carry stroller by ourselves each time), eat same buffet restaurant three times per day for the whole trip as it is hard to reserve other restaurant.   No one care about you, only care about selling their membership.

reviews.author: Chris D
reviews.title: Not so great
reviews.text:
So we decided to go to this hotel based on a recommendation from a friend.  Our friend had a small child at the time and I can see how the reserve would work, but for a family with 2 teens, not so much.  They were bored and basically the food sucks.  Even eating at the restaurants sux.  We are foodies so it’s hard for us to find good food, but I would rather eat McDonald’s then continue to eat at this buffet.  At least the buffet at the beach was slightly better with more offerings but really it sucks.  We had a hamburger on our arrival at the grill at the reserve and literally is was not cow.  It was some other animal, it was mauve in color and spongy.  Gross!
The frozen drinks are also barely frozen and very watery, but I continue to drink them in order to numb myself before eating a meal anywhere at this resort.
My oldest cut her toe in broken glass that was supposedly not allowed by the pool but somehow got there, and after we rushed her to the doctor to get taken care of and not one phone call to see how she was doing after the fact.  We had to beg to get bandaids!
Also this place is extremely windy and hard to enjoy time by the beach especially at night.  Could just be the time of year, but bring a sweatshirt.
There are plenty of better all inclusive family resorts to go to!

reviews.author: Fabio F
reviews.title: Boas instalações. Pior serviço possível.
reviews.text:
O lugar é bonito, as instalações muito boas. Os quartos tiveram alguns problemas, mas na maioria resolvidos.
Entretanto, o serviço é horroroso. Nenhum funcionário se dispõe a resolver algo. A primeira resposta é sempre NÃO, ou sem resposta, em virtude de muitas vezes estarem ocupados em conversar entre si, ou no celular "muito ocupados". Não localizei nenhum gerente ou alguém que assumisse alguma responsabilidade pelos problemas. Problemas foram muitos e desegradáveis. Até para chegar num campo de golfe o motorista foi embora, apesar de estarmos menos de 5 minutos atrasados, sendo que no dia anterior ele atrasou vinte minutos para chegar.
Para organizar um mergulho tivemos vários problemas, pois o funcionário encarregado da venda, tinha uma preocupação : La Propina.
Em resumo, péssimo serviço em todas as situações. Creio que o Management é ausente e omisso.

reviews.author: Cristopher G
reviews.title: Great hotel, terrible service.
reviews.text: Great hotel, terrible service. Paid for royal service  it received mediocre service at best. Didn’t even meet “personal concierge” the first two days there. Staff don’t even react to complaints, it’s as if “there’s no solution to your problems, tough luck”.

reviews.author: Aliceloveit
reviews.title: Good hotel, great golf, average service, and trying to sell me timeshare ? common Melia
reviews.text:
I could have rated this hotel "Very Good". We stayed for 12 days in December, played golf everyday and enjoyed it. 
The room was good, clean, with only one complain, Who on earth has decided to use a curtain to separate the bathroom from the room ? I like my privacy and it was not there. Clear the toilet and shower have a glass door but this was very annoying at night, you can't use light or it shine on the whole room and of course all the "toilet" noises are shared with the whole room. 
The food at buffet was a little repetitive after a while but still was good and we enjoyed the "indian food" part of the buffet. 
Food experience outside the buffet was really not good, the dominican night, seems to be a reduced buffet options, the bbq on the beach was also a let down and we are absolutely not fan of eating in the wind, food was cold. We tried only one restaurant the Grill "Rare", yes rare it was... The portion were ridiculous, I had the beef carpaccio it was 6 paper thin slice of beef, so thin I had to scrap them from the plate, my other half had the Rare salad with Feta cheese, only a few scrap were present. The main course was sub-par a french fries portion barely fit for a toddler, dry chicken (no sauce) and ribs where kind of ok, but more bones than meat, no wonder we meet again many of the other customers back at the buffet, we went to the buffet as soon as we exited the "Rare" so did the others.. that tell all. 
The service at buffet overall was realy a hit and miss, disorganised most of the time, clearly some not motivated employees, few were good, the rest did what they could do, but we had same experience at other hotels in Punta Cana so it was expected.
Loved to go to the lobby bar for the drinks, they did very good cocktails and provided great service, one of the rare area where service was constantly good.
The golf, we played everyday, the Cocotal course was great, not crowded and very very well maintained, since it was not crowded it was very flexible for start time. 

No the ugly part. Being tricked by the hotel to go into the Circle club Timeshare presentation was what made us pissed. We get a call in the evening in the room that they forgot to give us the "hotel credit vouchers" so we have to come collect next day, which we did. Of course the desk to collect them is just in front of the "Circle" room, the person who gave us the credit also used trick and lie (blatant lie..) actually we did go because he said that he earn 50$ for each person that he can sign up for the presentation (but dont mention that he said that to his manager), since we had time we said ok, then a lady came with a form which we had to fill, I left informations about earning and credit card blank of course. Second lady come and want to bring us to the Circle hotel for a visit which we refused we were just back from golf and wanted to have lunch. So a sales man came to help and finally we sit in the Circle room where they present what we discover to be timeshare holiday... It did not go long before I moved into fight mode as asked the questions that hurt them, so they soon realised that they will get nothing from us. 

If you go and think you could be interested, just first do some research on internet about Club Melia as it's totally similar to the Circle, the word scam come quite often in the reviews.

It's a pity as I would have given a "Very Good" review, if not "Excellent" but fact that I am tricked an lied to make for a poor experience. Will I return to this hotel ? I would have,  but now I will avoid Melia hotels, there are others good hotels in Punta Cana, that's where I will head next time I return.

reviews.author: Sara de Oliveira
reviews.title: Insatisfação
reviews.text:
Em minha viagem a Punta Cana, fiquei 3 diárias no resort para conhecer o local, no entanto tive uma experiência que não foi das melhores. Passei 6 diárias no resort vizinho e da mesma rede Meliã (The Level) onde não tive do que reclamar tendo em vista que sempre fui muito bem atendida por todos os funcionários e a estrutura do resort me atendeu muito bem!

No entanto parece que o “primo rico” da rede perde em vários requisitos, pois mesmo apesar de toda a “pompa” falha em diversos aspectos. 

O motivo do meu descontentamento foi o fato dos meus filhos ficarem com fome em um resort all inclusive. E você ver seu filho com fome e chato demais.

Saímos do resort para um passeio de parte do dia e as crianças acabaram dormindo cansada no retorno do passeio e quando acordaram, saímos do quarto para comer no horário mais ou menos ás 21h50.

Para entender, os restaurantes temáticos ficam abertos até às 21h45 e o restaurante buffet até as 22h30, segundo informações do recepcionista, no entanto o que aconteceu foi que antes das 22h00 o buffet já estava encerrado, assim como todos os restaurantes. 

E me informaram que somente as 23h00 iriam abrir o restaurante com snacks (hambúrguer, batata frita...), aí teria que aguardar 1 hora para meus filhos comerem. Minha filha não aguentou e dormiu com fome, meu filho como é  um pouco mais velho conseguiu aguardar. E detalhe o restaurante com snacks atrasou e foi liberado mais ou menos as 23h30.

No entanto o conceito de All inclusive acaba fugindo quando vc sente fome por mais de 1 hora com uma criança, sendo que a outra acabou dormindo com fome. 

O resort é bem mais caro que o vizinho The Level, no entanto lá, na hora que sentíssemos fome, teria um quiosque cheio de coisas boas para nos atender. 

Fui reclamar com o recepcionista e o mesmo informou que deveria aguardar as 23h00, enfim, meu filho passou mais de uma hora com fome por completa falta de organização do hotel, em que o buffet que funcionaria até as 22h30,havia encerrado antes das 22h00. 

E acabou que os snacks que seriam liberados as 23h00, só foram liberados as 23h30, mais uma vez, por completa falta de organização.

Eu esperava mais, esperava bemmmm mais de um Resort padrão luxo que nesse sentindo e em vários outros perde feio para o The Level at meliã. 

Tenho certeza que dei um tremendo azar, pois creio que tenha sido um caso isolado, mas que foi uma situação bem chata é que marcou de forma ruim parte da nossa estadia. 

Esse post foi apenas para demonstrar minha insatisfação. O resort tem uma
Estrutura maravilhosa, no entanto peca em algumas coisas. Depois faço uma outra a avaliação exaltando o que tem de bom!

reviews.author: José Henrique C
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text:
Firs of all I would like to say that Luis Sanchez was the most amazing and thoughtful butler to me and my wife. He deserves to be congratulated for a great service.

Overall my experience wasn’t so great. I payed for this hole trip on January with my credit card, since it was my honeymoon I had high expectations of everything and wanted to pay and reserve everything early. I paid with my credit card in January, but the card expired in October, so the company sent me a new one. When I arrived at the hotel they asked me for the card that I used to fullfil the payment in January, I explained that the card had expired and I had a new one. They told me that I had to pay AGAIN, and that they would give me a letter and a reembursment. I tried to explain for HOURS that it didn’t make any sense, because the card was payed in February, and even showed them the confirmation that everything was payed already. So I had to pay for EVERYTHING again, which was ridiculous, and they still haven’t returned my money. The worst part is that the money that I had to spend again was reserved in my credit card limit to pay for other things. So now I can’t do the tours and things that I planed because I don’t have limit in my card. 

I have been in hotels all over the world and never seen this happen, I’m still in chock.

Another thing that was disturbing is that people try to sell you things ALL THE TIME, even inside the hotel. Is hard to have some peace in here when they are constantly being inconvenient.

The service in the restaurants wasn’t very good, except  in passion that was great. The Italian restaurant gaved us some dessert that was clearly out of expiration date.

I expect to get my money back soon, or I will persue legal measures.

If it wasn’t for Luis my entire experience would have been terrible.

Thank you.

reviews.author: Explore276358
reviews.title: bad food for breakfast and lunch
reviews.text: a lot of mosquito bites  in the room !!!! food was a very bad experience more like shelter meal at the buffet Naosfor breakfast and lunch and , for all inclusive rate this is abad onethe resort it self is nice

reviews.author: Cako O
reviews.title: Paradisus  Palma Real no cuesta lo que te ofrece
reviews.text:
Hotel con decoración muy linda .
Habitación con cucarachas.
TELEVISORES VIEJOS
Muchos restaurantes para cenar, hay que reservar (vinos son pagos y caros) 
Un solo restaurante para el almuerzo .(los mosos no retiran los platos usados y no tienen autoservicios de bebidas, hay pedirlas al moso ,que te la trae cuando estas terminando la comida
El Bar no tiene carta de tragos  
NO VOLVEREMOS

reviews.author: Bozena S
reviews.title: Club Melia members
reviews.text:
While the resort is very nice and most of the staff are friendly- I feel like being a member of club Melia is a humongous waste of money. First when making the reservation by phone, since they have not invested or updated the website in years and you have to call
I asked to be in area where kids club is located - I didn’t know it was called The Reserve, but it was area we were told we would be staying in as members. It is the area with the lifestyle classes and better fitness center offerings. This is not where our room is located. So when we take our child to kids club we can not relax at that pool and have a drink as we have the wrong color band. To get the right color band would cost us over 200 for the week. In comparison if I was booking the same hotel room with out being a club member the difference in price was 87 for the whole week. 
Not only that, since last time we were here six years ago you can see they are cutting costs everywhere. 
Called multiple times first night for a blanket for sofa bed which never came. Asked to have the sofa bed made every night - fourth night was first time it happened. Still don’t have a reservation for beach cabana I was told would be made first night. 
It’s just very disappointing to know we spent many thousands of dollars to become members and would be getting the same room for less by booking online. 
I’m hoping to enjoy the rest of our time here, but I can’t shake the disappointment.

reviews.author: Getaway11186515970
reviews.title: MALA RELACION CALIDAD PRECIO
reviews.text: Considero que en este destino hay bastantes opciones que mejoran lo que ofrece Paradisus con menos dinero. Hemos estado alojados en varios hoteles durante nuestra estancia en Republica y el Paradisus es del que peor impresión me he llevado. NO cabe duda de que es un buen hotel con buenas instalaciones pero si lo comparas con otras opciones sale perdiendo

reviews.author: Leonardo L
reviews.title: MUY Mala comida. Se he deteriorado mucho el nivel del hotel
reviews.text:
Tercer año que venimos  a este hotel en Punta Cana, también somos clientes de Paradisus Playa del Carmen. Este año bajó muchísimo el nivel, la comida de lo peor que puede existir, realmente muy malo...... Además, muchos  de sus restaurantes cerrados. Miles de detalles de mal servicio, parecieran  estar  ahorrando costos o en crisis. En general uno escucha la misma critica sobre la mala comida de muchos huéspedes. 

Señores MELIA ojo con este hotel que afecta se marca y su cadena.

reviews.author: Jerry W
reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: We are very disappointed about the hotel restaurants. We are the reserved guests and there was no clear information that we have to make a reservation for the restaurants prior to check in. When we spoke to the front desk and the guest service, there was no resolution or follow up provided. We ended up having buffets for lunch and dinner. This is the first time I’m staying in the inclusive resort, and the experience was not that great.

reviews.author: shawna_bradshaw
reviews.title: Dissapointed.  Be careful staying in off season
reviews.text:
So we made the best of our family vacation but were very dissapointed in our experience.

Kids loved the kids club even though they did not follow the schedule that was given. Kids were very excited for lots of different activities that never happened. But  Michel, Xavier and Jack were amazing. 

We had family concierge which was very nice Jose Jones was very nice and tryed to help is as much as possible but it is hard to make our experience when there is no communication to your staff. 

The bar staff at the swim up bar and around the pool were wonderful. (Sorry no names)  

Urvania Lorenzo I can't say enough. She remembered my girls every time we ate at the gabi club. 

Unfortunately no for the cons (and really I was hoping for the best)

Food
Very disappointing in the buffets. Not much variety very similar every night and very small.  Nothing for the picky kids to eat no fires or pizza or chicken finger not even make your own pasta station. Breakfast was good omelette station but bacon was terrible. Bread was not fresh.  Different salads were good but definatly recycled for previous nights. 

Ala cartes well.....  Only 4 open the entire week and on opposite nights. Vento was really good service was great. Mexican restaurant did not interest us.  Fergo we never go into cause it was booked.  The grill was okay steaks over cooked. At one point though out the week a few of us had stomach issues. One of the travellers was in bed for 18 hours. Beware and trust me we travel regularly. I could not even talk about the asian and italian cause they were closed the entire week. 

 Kids nightly entertainment was almost non existent. Nightly entertainment Lion king twice in one week. Really we could do better. 

There was no enertainment around the pool and it was to much zen music. We are use to music amd activites around the pool and though out the resort. 

Housekeeping was good when it was done before 4 pm in the afternoon.  Which was never.  

Beware when we arrived nothing was said about restaurants, main pool  and an entire resort being closed. I paid for the reserve and everyone from the Paradisus Punta cana was upgraded to nicer rooms for no extra charge. If i had known I would have not booked this resort. 

The emails i have received  in regards to my concerns have been terrible. They don't care. 

My experience and the value of this resort was not up to 5 star standards.  And I was so looking forward to a 5 star experience.

reviews.author: Davidmurod
reviews.title: Donde esta nuestro hotel?
reviews.text:
Hace 2 años estuvimos en el hotel y salimos encantados en todos los aspectos.
Por eso volvimos pero ahora fue diferente.
Te encontrabas a personal del hotel que le costaba ser simpático, poniendo incluso mala cara al pedir un plato de pasta en el buffet, el cual ha bajado la calidad bastante.
Como puede ser que de todo el personal del buffet el unico que fuera amable y alegre fuera Fausto, tratando a todos por igual y sin dar preferencia a personas, sin mencionar nacionalidad, que dejaban buenas propinas, parece que están supeditados al cliente adinerado, una pena que el jefe directo no esté alli para cerciorarse.
La animación del hotel es inexistente, donde queda Shaky Shaky, Lucky lucky y compañía? Que pena de hotel en este sentido.
A tener en cuenta la "reunion de 30 minutos" para ofrecerte el nuevo hotel Circle a cambio de un regalo; se convierte en 3 horas donde un comercial agresivo ofrece hacerte "socio exclusivo" a cambio de hipotecar tus vacaciones según tus posiblidades económicas ( esto último es lo que le importaba al que nos adjudicaron).
Las instalaciones siguen siendo un espectáculo, pocos como el Paradisus.
Muy bueno el restaurante Bana.
Una decepción bajo nuestro criterio.

reviews.author: CORTEAZY
reviews.title: Great Disappointment
reviews.text:
Buyer beware. We ended up on The Reserve by Paradisus after purchasing packages for 2 families for Paradisus Beachfront Resort. We are not frequent luxury travelers. We normally stay at Super8's and Comfort Inns to give you an idea of who we are. We all work super hard and save up every year to do these family getaways. We tip, we mingle, we laugh, we speak the language so it's always a great time no matter where we go. We never want to go home. But this place, we all wanted to go home after 3 days. 

I'll get the good stuff out of the way quickly. The property is beautiful. From outside, it all looks neat and hospitable. The beach is a good size. 25 minutes away from the airport so transport is quick. I can see the potential. The positive reviews I read are believable yet unbelievable after my experience, maybe we had an off week. 

Oct3-Oct11, 2018
Upon arrival, we were told they took our money for the beachfront and put us at the reserve instead due to some renovations on the property. You know the look of the customer service people when they know they're telling you something messed up?  Yeah, that's the face that greeted us.  It took 5 of them to check us in because I'm pretty sure they expected retaliation. Go #teamwork. To make up for the switch up, our rooms were 'upgraded' and gave us adjoining rooms and sweet talked us to death with how much better The Reserve was than Paradisus. We saw right through their prepared dialogues.  However, we are also easy going people and we figured OK, no beachfront, 20min walk from the beach, there's still a pool, we need to walk off all the food we're going to eat anyway, let's do it. Go Punta Canaaaa!

Entering the property we quickly realized after asking our concierge, the Reserve ends up being attached to Paradisus so the renovations they told us about on the beachfront were going to be affected us anyways. Restaurants were closed. Services were not available. Because we are a group and saw reviews that securing tables was a problem for some couples, we called the hotel from Canada to try and make our arrangements before our trip. The hotel staff told us not worry, all our requests could be accommodated once we arrive. That would have been a good time to mention 5 of the restaurants we asked about were closed. So by now, everyone is starting to get that ripped off feeling.  

Enter the rooms...they gave us a king bed and pull out. The pull out was already dressed up like a bed so this change in plan was premeditated, clearly.  The family we traveled with had the same pull out dressed up like a bed.  They at least had 2 twin beds and a pull out. Our kids took the real bed. The wife tried the pullout with me the first night but it messed up her back and she furiously squeezed in on the kids bed after.  It's very unfortunate when you save all year and buy a "luxury" package to a 5-star resort and you end up on a crappy pull out. If you're a married man, you already know the tension and attitude you have to deal with from an unhappy wife. 

If the bad stuff ended here, I think we would have still enjoyed our stay. But it didn't end here.

When we checked in, they told us our $1,000 resort dollars would be given the next day. When we asked about them again, they said please come back later. By now, we are reading reviews for The Reserve since we never bothered looking at them before when we were invested in researching the Paradisus Beachfront resort. There were recent reviews showing people were being cheated out of their resort dollars. On the 3rd day, us two husbands came storming the lobby determined to get what we were promised. It was a winning factor in our destination selection. After 30 minutes of explaining and re-explaining to a supervisor, fighting for our vouchers, they handed us a coupon book. A coupon book to other nearby shops in Punta Cana. We felt very cheap and embarrassed to find out we were grown men arguing over coupons we are not going to use.  Read the fine print. Check the word play. Very deceiving. That was a huge disappointment. I did not come to spend $200 US dollars at jewelry store to save $10. I don't think they even had coupons for standard things like Scuba diving or excursions. Just shopping. So frustrating. 

The Food: These people kept 2 a la carte restaurants open to still qualify for a 5-star property during their off season. Smart. They also recycled food.  Re-heated and re-used the buffet food all week. The entres we were ordering from the a la cartes were being served in the buffet the next day.  Left overs I bet. Fried foods tasted like wet cardboard. I don't know how you get bacon wrong, but these people did it. Imagine plastic jerky. The only thing we found edible was the grill of the day which stayed consistent all week as well. My kids wouldn't eat the damp cereal from the little cereal boxes they usually love.  They wouldn't even eat the cheese pizza. My kids eat everything by the way! Like for real.
We all sufficed with a toast and omelette diet for breakfast and rice and grilled fish or chicken - all week. Nothing else was fresh or good. The meats gave us the runs.

Mole mexican restaurant was descent.  The Grill, not so much. And Fuego was a joke. It was practically the same food as The Grill with asian jarred sauces on top and questionable sushi freshness. 

We tried out the kids zone. The place you're apparently able to leave your kids with someone and go out.  I stayed with mine. There was one employee at the front, nice lady. But she's on her phone and the kids area was behind her and there's a whole outside backyard to it and no one was watching the outside except me. I did not feel confident leaving my 2yo or 4yo there with just her there. Other kids were there, also with their parents, probably for the same reason.  So that was a joke. And you could only play video games on one console from 5pm-6pm you had to be share with other kids. I love taking my kids away from video games but when they're having such a crappy vacation and it's raining everyday,  you kind of feel bad for them. 

Do not accept the 'tour of their new building for a free dolphin ride".  It's a scam.  Another guest we met said they wasted an entire morning of his day with their timeshare presentation over breakfast and they did not make good on their free offer.  They will ask you every day.  They even called our room once.  I told them to stop asking, I was beginning to feel pressured and there was no way I was taking a boat ride to see the dolphins anyway. It rained everyday and the ocean water was super choppy.  Tell them to leave you alone. Be firm. 

For the first 6 days of our trip, we tipped, we mingled, we tried.  We speak the language so we do good for ourselves in Dominican. But we quickly realized that the service was very poor. No one checked on you during your meal to top up drinks or offer coffee or anything. We had to waive people down for stuff.  Anywhere else we've stayed, they see the baby or the stroller and they automatically bring you a high chair. We had to ask for it every time and sometimes ask 2 or 3 times. One time, it finally came as we were leaving. The family I traveled with actually got so upset with the hotel once he was yelling on the phone at someone. He'll be writing his own review. 

Housekeeping was late every day. We left the room 7-8am every day to enjoy the pool, find food to eat, walk around and do as much as we could before the rain hit every day until about 5-6pm to get ready for night time fun and the rooms were either still dirty or being cleaned around then. We would get in their way, and us in theirs. This was pretty consistent throughout or stay. 

The Casino. What a joke. They panic when you win and winning as little as $20 causes so much commotion.  There's not enough cash to cash out, please take your voucher and come back tomorrow. Just a joke.  My wife came back with a $50 voucher once and I said that's great honey, cash out.  She said she can't. She used a COUPON to play and she can only use it at the casino to play more. I never understood what the hell was going on in there. I stayed away from it.  

Room service was OK. We tipped them better than everyone else. But the people who stock the fridge were constantly out of juice boxes. We traveled with small kids. You have to have juice. They only gave us a milk box and 1 or 2 juices every day.  If you ask for more, they're all out. 

Bellboys: One night, my wife, myself, my kids and my friend's kid were out waiting for a buggy to take us over to Gabi Beach. We were the first ones there. It rained all day and night that day so we didn't want to walk 20min to the beach in the pouring rain at night. Stoller and all, waiting, the buggy finally arrives and the bell boy hurries all the adults onto the car and leaves us out. As he sent the vehicle on its way we made eye contact and he knew he messed up. He looked at us standing there in the rain like .... dude. And he hurried to use the phone to call another cabby. He then said, if we wait some more, the next car can take us half way there. The rain is flooding the roads.  I looked at him again and said dude, you really think waiting here some more after that, for a buggy to take my family half way there is helpful? Are you serious right now?  And he had no words. We stayed in that night. Had enough disappointment from the day already to be messing around in the rain at night with this type of "help" around. 

Towards the end of our stay, we started seeing supervisors walking around and the service got noticeably better. There was ketchup and mustard on the tables all of a sudden, cheddar cheese was available for cheese burgers, french fries!, The buffet food smelled fresher, the options got better, there was even lobsters on the grill my last night at the buffet.  Waiters were checking on us at dinner and asking us if we wanted coffee, our kids were being asked if they wanted ice cream and juice... -Where the heck were all these people all week???? 

My best guess is, we came at the wrong time and they obviously had enough complaints to call in the big guns.  Although they made 1 of my 8 days feel like a 5-star vacation, I will never return here and tell all the people we travel with about this experience, especially Melia Hotels International.  There was no abundance, generosity, no pampering service, no Dominican vibe here. We've never had a problem at any of Meia's properties or Dominican in the past until now.  

BTW - Zen music and incense throughout the property made us feel like we were ruining the zen vibe for everyone else. All the other resorts in Dominican we've been to have salsa and meringue and happy music playing throughout the property.  The sounds of laughter, kids playing and fun.  Yours was eerie, too calm and not so fun.  Maybe If I was traveling by myself seeking my inner self lol  *Might want to think about that when you claim to cater to families.  Having a kids pool in the back isn't enough. You actually have to cater to them, with fun stuff.

There was one Foam party at the pool though. You must than whoever was responsible for that. The kids thought that was fun.  Even though it's more of an adults party theme... whatever.

reviews.author: luvluxhotels
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I used to love this place so much so this was my 4th visit. The service and staff were all I raved about and loved that they were there on each visit. This time it was practically all new faces, a lot more staff and they all had such an attitude. They weren’t friendly or welcoming rather they all seemed annoyed, bored and overall as if they hated their jobs and the guests. It was great while t lasted. I would never go back it chose Melia again

reviews.author: edmundo_osorio
reviews.title: Problemas y mal servicio
reviews.text: En este momento me encuentro hospedado acá en la habitación 3416 habiendo comprado en Paradisus Punta Cana Resort, pero como la piscina está en remodelación y la temporada es baja nos mudaron para acá, y es asi que comienzan los problemas siendo un “upgrade”. Desde problemas en la habitación con la luz, el teléfono, los muebles hasta los restaurants cerrados y una incongruencia en reservas. A pesar de la amabilidad del personal no es el servicio que uno espera al gastar 5300 dólares en una semana de vacaciones (incluido pasajes obviamente). Si algun Gerente del Melia o de Circle me lee, yo si estoy esperando una compensación, me quedo hasta el 15 con ustedes.

reviews.author: Escape754975
reviews.title: Better options elsewhere
reviews.text: I can’t really recommend this place. However this was my first time in the DR. I have since been told a lot of other places in the country have the same problem, especially the food. Rooms were nice if sometimes a far walk from the beach. AC was very good. Food was terrible. Beach was nice but lots of people try to sell you something. All in all not bad but better places in region. Hard to relax given the above and there were a lot of little things. Showers did not have hot water the first day and a half. They were out for the whole building, but after our third call they finally committed to fix it. It was hot out so wasn’t that worried about it, the crazy part was they then sent a guy to each room that conplained to show how to work the shower and have him say we had been doing it wrong. I know the water was out both from other guests at the resort and a staff member so it was a really weird thing to lie about. They also sent a male janitor into the women’s spa locker room to clean it without telling anyone and while women were in there changing.
