Not all restaurants were included too.  Several you had to pay.  This resort is not all-inclusive.  While I am happy to tip the maids, waiters/servers and bartenders, tipping to get a table at an all-inclusive is CRAZY. 
The only beer offered was Presidente and alcohol was low-tier.  A margarita with Patron tequila was an upgrade of $15 PER DRINK.  
Spanish speaking guests were given preferential treatment.  
My room key had to be reprogrammed about 5 times during our stay because it often didn't work. 
Each time I called 0 for help due to endless glitches (including no towels, no beer in fridge, no bottled water) the phone was answered in Spanish and I needed to ask for English. 
Service was poor.  Every morning trying to grab a table for 6 was a challenge.  The hostesses were often incompetent.  One tried to add place settings without wiping down the table.  
On our last day my husband carried 6 chairs from the pool (with a constant blasting soundtrack of only Pitbull songs) down to the beach.  NO ONE was available to help and NO ONE offered assistance.  Only after the chairs were moved did a manager come over to apologize.   
The gym had very outdated equipment and had only 5 treadmills & 3 elliptical machines.  There was a line every morning & many frustrated guests just gave up waiting and left.  My husband got hurt when his treadmill turned off during a run due to another guest accidentally kicking a ball placed in an unsafe location which hit the treadmill belt.  Nothing was done.  
Taking out money was a hassle (the teller wanted an extra 70 dollars to take out 200) and the front desk never had change. 

I do believe at times that Paradisus was trying to make amends for all of the problems we had, but sending a bottle of wine (standard bottle of red which was included) and a plate of cheese, crackers & fruit immediately after breakfast was not the best way to apologize.The plate didn't fit in the refrigerator and we were full.  Weird.    

Wi-fi was very spotty and a few of the kids got sick. 

Maybe the Royal Service guests had a better experience than us, but NOTHING was luxury at the Paradisus Palma Real.  HUGE disappointment.

reviews.author: Firahs45
reviews.title: Wasn't as expected
reviews.text:
We just returned from a one week vacation at the Reserve and I have to say, I had high hopes for the Reserve, which unfortunately were not met! Don't get me wrong, the Paradisus complex is HUGE, absolutely breathtaking and immaculately kept. The beach and the pools are also fantastic. 

However, in my opinion, this is where the positives stop and the cons start taking over. This resort has a MAJOR issue with its customer service culture (or lack thereof!). Despite the fact that we met many wonderful staff who truly understood what good customer service was all about, we cannot forget the poor experience of dealing with quite a few other staff, who appeared disgruntled, frustrated and indifferent. As a side note, tipping did not help improve their service!

 Aside from the above issues, I believe there is a systemic problem with efficiency of service delivery at this resort. As some other reviewers have also commented, a case in point was restocking the minibar. This is supposed to be something routine and rather trivial, but not at this resort! It could take you at least half dozen phone calls before you can see 2 bottles of water in the minibar. I felt that the problem was something that was going to the top of their "Service" department, because they seemed to operate on an ad hoc basis without a proper tracking system for orders. As a result of that, orders would get easily lost and almost all the time, they were delivered incorrectly. This was something that you could see present at some of the bars and restaurants.

Another disappointing issue was the state and set up of the suites. The rooms have obvious signs of wear and tear. If you are banking on using the sofabed for sleeping your teenager, do NOT! It is completely useless and will give them a good back pain every morning. Also, as many others have commented, the walls are paper thin so you can hear your neighbors loud and clear! Lastly, many of the rooms face the service road which is the main artery for this resort so you should expect to hear all sorts of vehicles 24/7.

Overall, I would give it the highest marks for the beach, pools and the property itself but very poor marks for the service and just OK marks for the rooms.

reviews.author: CheminNantel
reviews.title: Dissappointing
reviews.text:
Our experience was very dissappointing.
Most of the staff seemed very unhappy.
Not enough staff.  We found if we asked for anything, the waiters were rude or looked annoyed, but I think is was because they were over worked.
Most of the food was cold or luke warm.
We were part of a large group, 8 of us had upset stomachs a lot of the time, we were only there for 7 days.
Our room was not as clean as we expected.
Poor hygiene standards.
The Only Positives:-
Beautiful beach area and pool area.

reviews.author: Kristin M
reviews.title: Large Group Meeting
reviews.text:
Before I begin I must say that I have been here twice; both times for a work outing of about 80 people so this review might be different if it wasn't such a large group. 

Pros:
The resort is beautiful and very large
The buffet restaurant (naos I believe) was very good with many options
Room is nice (but not private at all)

Cons:
The food. Almost my entire group got sick. This could have been from the majority of our food being catered and not going to the restaurants but even still, the food needs to be sanitary (it was directly catered from the resort).
Mosquitos and bugs were bad.
Very large language barriers 
Housekeeping cleaned our room and TOOK OUR PHONES AND WALLETS SITTING OUT AND MOVED THEM. Granted we shouldn't have left the belongings out but housekeeping took our valuables and put them in our safe and locked it with their own code. So when we returned to the room we assumed they were stolen due to no note or anything being left. We had to have security come and help us (he wasn't very nice and blamed us). 
Only two beers, neither being a light beer. 
Housekeeping would take dirty towels but not replace them with clean. 

Overall, even though it was not a great experience as a work outing, I would never stay here for personal.

If you are debating between the DR and Mexico, hands down go to Mexico. 

Tip for anyone coming from out of the country: Do not check a bag if you can get away with it. There is no order to their airport and the lines will take you over an hour just to check your bag. Security will take your belongings (I'm assuming to just keep for their own). They took a portable charger that had been cleared by TSA for approval. With the language barrier they wouldn't give it back.

reviews.author: victorpS681YU
reviews.title: Read Reviews Carefully
reviews.text: We read all of the reviews before booking and just like everyone else were very impressed. We found out very quickly upon arrival that those reviews reflect the Reserve section. I will not go into the particulars, there are just too many to list. But signs at at every turn and angle saying Reserve only, Royal service only and family concierge only are very distasteful. It seems that they enjoy the separation of people into categories.

reviews.author: Sabitha S
reviews.title: Waiting for info for child with food allergies
reviews.text: We have a reservation for December 2015 to stay at Paradisus Palma for a week. We are traveling with a child who has food allergies and is a vegan. I have called and emailed them a few times trying to get some specific information about my child's dietary needs and what we can expect or be prepared for when we get there. So far no one has responded to any of my emails. When we call, I am directed to guest services where I have to leave a message and still don't hear back from anyone. Someone at the front desk said we can go there and talk to them. I am not sure I want to take that risk. Having second thoughts now about this resort now :(

reviews.author: abogadosean
reviews.title: Kid Zone is great-room cleaning service a nightmare
reviews.text: The Kid Zone was wonderful for my 11 year-old. Great option to be able to relax during the day. However, the cleaning staff continually barged into my room even with the "No Molestar" Do Not Disturb card on the door. One cleaning lady appeared shocked to see a naked over 50 year old guess standing there. Another time, the eager water bottle guy barged in when I had on head phones and was playing my guitar. I did not hear the door knock or open and nearly had a heart-attack. Another time, the bottle boy barged in again. The staff explained that even though the back side of the purple card that says "Do Not Disturb" is blank (nothing written at all), "it means come in and clean or service the room"! En serio? I guess they don't understand what people who read and write might think. They clean crew regularly congregated outside the door and talked loudly at 10 am... If that is my only complaint, then things were not so bad-however for the price, they should respect privacy.

reviews.author: blakeedwardb
reviews.title: nope
reviews.text: never again. dirty. stunk. no lights. no maps on where stuff is. no assistance. adventures are poor quality and high price. dont go. waste of money. laksfkasdjfklajslkfaskldjflkasdjfkajsdkfjalsdjflkasjflkasjd

reviews.author: MayZ19
reviews.title: Not very attentive staff
reviews.text: This is a very beautiful resort in terms of its location and view. But if you are looking for great service on this resort, their staffs are not very attentive overall. I would recommend STAY OUT of it.

reviews.author: Qiao Chan G
reviews.title: Punta Cana 9/2015
reviews.text: I probably won't come back to this place, didn't have a great experience at all.  Check-in and dinner reservations were horrible. The resort ground is nice but the hotel rooms are out dated and needs a lot of repairs.

reviews.author: Sheila W
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text:
My family and I spent 2 weeks at the reserve at paradissus punta Cana. Let me start by saying that the reserve is beautiful, well maintained with lots of restaurants with decent food. The beach is just gorgeous, they did a good job of managing the sea weed issues. Ramon at the beach was good, David the spin instructor at the gym was terrific!
On the negative side, customer service was appalling to say the least. I have been to many resorts and have never experienced anything like this. I would go as far as to say that the customer service experience was on the verge of being rude. We learnt pretty quick that to get reasonable service you had to tip beforehand rather than after the service as is customary. The mini bar was never restocked, I filled out the form asking to restock the mini bar I called requesting water and the response I got was " I will see what I can do" needless to say the water did not show up. My husband did not find the bed comfortable and the sound the ceiling fan made kept him awake. Room service was extremely slow and it was a challenge to get them to answer the phone. My nephews would place their breakfast orders and sometimes the food would not show up and then when we would call to find out what the delay was we were met with a disgruntled response that the order was never placed basically calling us liars!! The Mj show was really good but the bars were very dull , a couple of times they would shut early regardless of the number of people there it was really bad. I could go on and on but as for me and my family we would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: EmanuelRodri
reviews.title: Servicio muy malo
reviews.text:
Mi estadía empezó mal desde el momento en que llegamos. Nos tenian que dar las pulseras y hacer el ckeck in. De muy mala manera, demoraron demasiado, poco serviciales y no nos explicaron como era el servicio del hotel. Luego no había nadie para que nos llevara las valijas a la habitación, y no dejaban que nosotros la llevaramos (tampoco me decian donde quedaba, que espere...). Agarre las valijas y me fui solo luego de 15 minutos de espera.
La estructura del hotel es muy linda, la pileta gigante, la playa muy linda.
Gimnasio completo.
Hay un spa cerca de la pileta y la playa, que esta bueno, pero mejor es otro que hay que tomar un carrito para ir. Tiene duchas, sauna, seco y humedo, pileta fria para mejorar circulación, caminata sobre piedras, jacuzzi. Totalmente relajante y en un lugar ambientado al estilo oriental con mucha paz. Excelente!
Boliche muy lindo, bien decorado, chiquito, pero está bien para el hotel.
La habitación muy grande y cama comoda. Pero no se puede cerrar para que quede oscura!!!! Hay una ventana que da cerca a la cama y entra luz a las 6 de la mañana. Y también tuvimos problemas con la luz. Se prende con sensores, en la ducha no hay sensor asique para bañarnos con la luz prendida, la otra persona debia estar en movimiento dentro de la habitacion. 
Al lado de la bañera tenia una cortina que estaba rota, por lo que no podiamos usarla.
Ante estas quejas vinieron a arreglar 2 veces. No funcionó, nos mudamos a otra habitacion mas cerca de la playa, en la cual la cortina tambien estaba rota y por la mañana se escuchaba la musica del restaurant que servian el desayuno.
La atención de los mozos y barman muy mala. Atienden primeros a los canadienses y yanquis ya que les dejan propina todo el tiempo (les muestran el dinero antes de pedir). Siempre había que esperar a que atendieran, se olvidaban de los pedidos...
La comida muy buena siempre, de gran calidad y variada.
Las bebidas no son de la categoría para ese hotel. Si no aclarás que marca querés te sirven la barata y mala, la de rango medio (ej vodka Smirnoff, Stolichnaya) a veces tenían, otras no. Las marcas caras se pagan extra.
Me pasó que en el bar de la pileta, además de atender primero a los canadienses y yanquis, le pedia una marca y decian que no tenian, cuando se veía la botella escondida, se los dije y se hacian los desentendidos. También en ese bar a veces habia solo 1 persona atendiendo. Y simpre con mala gana.
Los que hacian excelentes tragos, con las marcas que correspondian y muy buena atención era en el bar del lobby (Lioni y alguien mas que no recuerdo). LO MEJOR DEL SERVICIO DEL HOTEL.
NO accedan al almuerzo / charla para vender el Club, es perder el tiempo. Prometen cosas que no cumplen.
Otro detalle del hotel: hay gente que pide comida a la habitación, luego saca la vajilla al corredor y puden pasar 12 horas que nadie la retira de ahi.
No volvería por el pesimo servicio.

reviews.author: AdelefromCanada
reviews.title: Punta Can't (no more buffets please)
reviews.text:
It has been years since my last confession on TripAdvisor. I confess: we hopped on a plane and expected to find Heaven at The Reserve.
The gracious, warm, friendly staff are wonderful.  
The grounds and pools are wonderful. The weather here in Punta Cana is wonderful. 
So how can this experience be anything less than wonderful? 
With 21 meals to eat over our 7 night stay, many days ago we began discussing what could have been our food experience here. At The Reserve a guest has the choice of 3 different restaurants for breakfast and brunch (exclusively buffet dining style) with all of the same food choices: (very hard) churros; pressembled bagels with salmon/lettuce; cold cuts; premade scrambled eggs, dollar size premade pancakes and 'crepes', (frozen) hash browns, etc. 
This dining style becomes tiresome quickly. The food is on par with a Holiday Inn Express morning breakfast that one quickly grabs out of necessity on the way to a work conference seminar in Windsor. The breakfast and brunch here at The Reserve is not quite good enough to be more than mediocre. With such bountiful beauty here at The Reserve it is difficult to fathom why the dining option for breakfast and brunch is so poor. 
Why must these particular meals of the day be so uninspiring. There is so much waste at the end of these dining times that they should consider made to order sit down meals rather than buffet style dining, there would less waste and mediocrity. 
If I am capable of Googling Emeril Lagasse Buttermilk Pancakes back home to satisfy my own teens with the most simple of recipes then why can't the restaurants here do the same as a bare mimunim. 
It feels unbelievable that this resort is rated at #3 out of 98 resorts overall in Punta Cana with this calibre of dining. 
Except for Vento, where we were delightedly served baked chocolate soufflé, every other dessert option has been on par with Sara Lee frozen foods. Come on Reserve you have the ingredients; bake something yourselves for diners please. 
A beautiful restaurant with freshly baked pastries, breads and simple brunch fare served with real coffee (no more cappuccinos from a Nespresso machine please) would be wonderful about now. The gracious staff at The Reserve would make that type of experience worthwhile.

reviews.author: Doug B
reviews.title: Prepare for a Vacation Club/Timeshare Pitch Upon Arrival
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from a week at this resort. We take several vacations a year and very carefully research each property we choose. Tripadvisors high rating and favorable comments were key to our decision. Unfortunately there were a number of issues that negatively impacted our stay that we feel obligated to warn others that their stay could be impacted as well. 

We had the following issues during our stay:
1) Warm welcome upon arrival until after our check in. A tour of the facility was promised after we ate lunch and never happened. We ultimately had to find our way around on our own. 
2) Vacation club/timeshare pitch - the concierge planned this event for us without discussing it with us in advance (1.5-2 hrs.). When we questioned what it was for the answer was a little vague but I figured it out (via online research) and rescheduled it twice. We finally attended only to help our concierge get her commission. Please be warned that this is a HIGH PRESSURE SALES PITCH. Nowhere is this mentioned on their website or the Melia Rewards site. VERY DECEPTIVE practice. We got no free rooms or special discounts to attend this. 
3) Rooms are beautiful BUT we had to ask for bottled water (part of mini bar) everyday. Since you cannot drink the tap water this is critical in the heat. Room doors are heavy and slammed constantly by everyone day and night. Incredibly loud. 
4) Service was consistently inconsistent. Good in the restaurants but not good by the pool or beach. Not service at the swim up bar. 

Lastly, the positives are the rooms (walls are thin - you will hear your neighbors) but they are beautiful. Nice outdoor deck. The grounds are beautiful as well. The food we equated to "cruise ship cuisine". Not great just ok. 

We will not book at another Melia resort based on the above. These issues ruined our vacation which is why the score is so low. Please consider these issues during your decision.

reviews.author: marcy179
reviews.title: NO ES LO QUE MUESTRAN
reviews.text: llegue hace una semana de este hotel, primero decir que e estado en hoteles en punta cana y otras cuidades que son de la misma categoria y de verdad el servicio es 5 estrellas este NO .primero el servicio no es lo que te vende la pagina de internet, que no menciona que si no eres socio del club melia o no pagaste el royal service no tienes acceso a todas las instalaciones del hotel , que a pesar de haber pagado una buen cantidad de dolares no puedes usar algunas piscinas y restaurant.Del personal decir que ellos te atienden solo si les das propinas , de lo contrario puedes esperar media hora y nadie te toma en cuenta, tienes que ir por tus tragos y bebidas de lo contrario te mueres de sed. El buffet malisimo y repetitivo , le falta mucha mantencion , no funciono nunca el jacussi , tuvimos que pedir reparacion para la ducha , el telefono,uff en fin .Que decir de los famosos asistentes que te ponen cuando llegas al hotel, que lo unico que quieren es venderte una membresia del club melia , no te dejan tranquilo ni por un minuto. fuimos por unas lindas vaciones con mi esposo pero nos vinimos muy decepcionados por haber elegido este lugar.

reviews.author: Apriljl
reviews.title: Bad Experience at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
I traveled with a group in August for a five night stay at the Reserve with Royal Service. The place is stunning and beautiful when you arrive and the beach and pools are very nice. I really wanted to love this place and the first two days there were great! Fun at the beach and pools, with great service.  The beach is beautiful and the service was phenomenal--never had to raise my hand for a drink. Unfortunately the rest of my trip went quickly downhill...

I regrettably I give the resort two stars because I came down with horrible stomach illness during and after my visit to the Paradisus--I'll spare details but it was quite painful.  It ruined my vacation, and I really wanted to love the Paradisus!

reviews.author: hannah c
reviews.title: need solution for cockroaches
reviews.text: I booked two separate rooms for me and my brother's family. we both found many cockroaches inside our rooms. Other than this, it was very nice and beautiful resorts.  Staff was very friendly.  But I don't want to go back there because of that cockroaches.  I found more than one during 4 nights stay at Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resorts.

reviews.author: downtune
reviews.title: Frown
reviews.text: We came to the resort for a wedding and had the butler service, and the four days we were there I do not remember seeing the butler one time. The food was horrible except for the Italian restaurant and my wife and I had to order room service and get pizza every night we were there. If I were you and your going to travel and there is a Sandals resort there, go there! The beaches were nice and the people were friendly but the service was just not there and I will never go back.

reviews.author: Daniel M
reviews.title: No se engañen por el nombre Melia
reviews.text: Cuartos viejos con olor a húmedo,  minibar con 2 latas de cerveza y 4 de gaseosa, bebidas dentro del paquete de pésima calidad, no vaya a la isla Sahona con las empresas que están en el hotel, servicio de Internet (dicen que hay pero lo que ofrecen es poco serio, no funciona), piscina sucia, en fin, no vale la pena

reviews.author: hemawong
reviews.title: Nothing to rave about
reviews.text: Front office staff was slow. Had to deal with my refund when I was in U.S. Staff barely spoke english. Food was okay. I most likely will not go back to that property. The DR yes, but will stay elsewhere.

reviews.author: Gilberto P
reviews.title: July 4 to july 11, compare with 5 years ago, poor food, CHECK IN worse of worse , poor service, bad food
reviews.text:
bad food, worse cheking , no friendly, bad service room, bad beach dirty , no dirty dirty , never can swining
bad food, restaurant no variety

el cheking lento y no amistoso, solamente los socios tenian buen servicio , ya perdio la calidad que tenian anos atras

reviews.author: Brent M
reviews.title: Nice property - but food abysmal!
reviews.text:
Our family of four spent 6 nights at the Reserve last week. We chose the Family Concierge program, and Elizabeth was available 24/7 to assist with any need we had - so that aspect was worth the money. While others have complained about lack shuttle service around the property - we did not have an issue (though they didn't seem to be booked anywhere near capacity this week). I will echo that having to fight through the seaweed in the surf proved to be more of a barrier than expected.. I knew it would be present, but swimming with 2 kids, and constantly having to un-entangle oneself from the large chunks of seaweed was a bit much after a while. Especially after seeing the GORGEOUS Macao beach just 20 minutes away - it was hard to go back to the resort beach after that.

Our consensus though was that the food was very much NOT at the level that it should be for an all-inclusive of this calibre (and cost). We ate at Fuego (good pork curry dish, but it lacked any side), Mole (which had a Cochinita Pibil that was saltier than a salt lick), Vento (decent, but not remarkable), The Grill (tasteless chimichurri sauce w/ a stack of pre-cooked steaks piled up by grill), Bana teppanyaki (where every meat was cooked in soy/terriyaki that tasted identical - regardless of whether it was beef, chicken, salmon, etc.). We also ate at Aqua (which had a lamb Osso buco that came out in the shape of a bowl, but the meat was more of a slurry w/o texture?). 

The various Buffets were really the worst part, since most of the restaurants are only open for dinner. These buffets served the EXACT same food for 6 days straight for breakfast, and the lunch options were just not appealing.. and that is saying something when I have a 10 year old boy that can devour just about anything! 

We did augment our meals with room service, which we appreciated for its convenience - but the food was essentially the same quality/flavor that we got at the pool grill or buffet.

I did my fair share of drinking, and found each bartender to be friendly, with reasonably strong drinks. I settled in one evening to have a cigar and a drink - and had a humorous exchange with one bartender who tried to convince me that Jim Beam was Scotch :) 

That being said - I still lost 2 lbs during this period - and I had fully expected to GAIN weight. The culinary highlight of our trip was the Wendy's at the Punta Cana airport on the way out - everyone agreed the chicken sandwiches had more flavor than what we had experienced the entire week!

Given that we paid ~$1,000 a day for our family to stay there - I fully expected a higher quality food service. I would STRONGLY recommend that management spend a few more of their profit dollars dramatically improving the food service - I am sure it would pay dividends in the long run.

reviews.author: kurt s
reviews.title: Hält nicht, was es verspricht, enttäuschend
reviews.text:
Sehr schöne, in die Jahre gekommene Anlage inmitten exotischer Gärten und an schönem, weißsandigem Palmenstrand mit angenehmen breiten Liegebetten. Geräumige, gut eingerichtete Zimmer. Hervorragende a la carte-Restaurants, besonders das Palazzo.

Ruhe gibt es wenig. Am Strand lärmen riesige US-Gruppen (übrigens auch in der Nacht beim Heimkommen), alle vorbeifahrenden Boote dröhnen vor Disco-Sound. Im Royal Service-Bereich werden (seit Jahren, wie man anhand anderer Bewertungen hier sieht) entgegen den Abmachungen ganze Haufen von Eltern mit Kindern einquartiert, die Verantwortlichen stellen sich dumm.

Der von weitem schöne Strand schockt, wenn  man in die Nähe kommt: 5 breit und 40cm türmen sich braune Algen- und Seegrastürme auf, Spezialfahrzeuge sind den ganzen Zag über im Einsatz, um das Zeug abzutransportieren.

Insgesamt trotz "royal service" eine herbe Enttäuschung.

reviews.author: Marcos D
reviews.title: Nice place, terrible service.
reviews.text:
Installations are ok, but the service and maitanance are really bad.
The team in general isn't prepared or trained to take care of tourists. In general, they are very disrespectful, terrible for a family experience. 
Problems with air, Internet, pillows, Mosquitos(a lot), reservations for dinner ...  Services and attractions out of the hotel are overpriced and dangerous. 
I do not recommend.

reviews.author: SK376
reviews.title: Nothing great unless you fork up for concierge service
reviews.text: We visited as a family with a total party of 14---6 adults and 8 kids.  Our stay was mediocre to poor.  The good things were that the grounds are beautiful and there are always spots near the pool to lounge. We were asked about joining the family concierge at check in.  We did not because of the additional cost.  We didn't realize this meant that there was essentially no service for the non-concierge guests.  There's no elevators so beware if you have babies/strollers. The rooms are freezing cold and you cannot adjust the thermostat. We could not get dinner reservations at any a la carte restaurants past 6pm. The only restaurants even available were Vento and Aqua.  We had to call housekeeping several times per day just to have our suites cleaned.  One day they actually didn't come to clean until 5pm.  Very skimpy on leaving towels/toiletry items. The shuttle golf carts to/from the beach were few and far between. Usually they were already half packed.  The room service line always went straight to an answering machine;we had to call the front desk.  The buffets at Gabi Club and Gabi beach had very small selections with little variation from day to day. Overall I was expecting so much more after the price tag this resort came with.  We have stayed at other all inclusives in Punta Cana and feel like this was a poor value.

reviews.author: Dionisio G
reviews.title: Gran decepción con las bebidas internacionales y preferencias con clientes y propinas
reviews.text:
Gran decepción con la bebida en los distintos bares ya que la mayoría no tenían bebidas internacionales solo nacionales y todos los camareros tienen preferencia con los extranjeros.

  Pude ver al bar tender Luis Rosario del bar Gabi beach el cual después de servirnos un whisky 12 años al volver nos dijo que se terminaron todos los whiskys 12 años y al pasar un momento le sirvió a otra persona y al exigirle el por qué me habia dicho que no había y solo pudo decir que no se acordaba haberme dicho que no había.

reviews.author: 961pierrealainp
reviews.title: Grosse déception
reviews.text:
Nous avons séjourné dans cet hotel du 14 au 23 mai et avions en grande partie choisi cet établissement pour l'excellent classement qu'il a sur Trip advisor ( numero 2 sur 99 hôtels a Punta Cana ).
-Le premier agacement a commencé le jour de notre arrivée lorsque l' on a commencé à essayer de nous vendre de manière insistante le " Royal service "... Nous arrivions à l'hotel en pensant avoir déja choisi le haut de gamme avec "the Reserve" , nous n'étions pas dans l'optique de rajouter 75 $ par personne par nuit pour 2 restaurants en plus et la carte des vins ...
-Deuxiéme point la nourriture des buffets : en qualité  ( genre pain pas frais du tout ) et en choix, les plus mauvais des 4 hotels que nous avons fait à Punta Cana et de loin.
-Ensuite concernant " the Reserve " , trop éloigné de la plage, on doit attendre les voiturettes à chaque fois
-Les animations sportives sont annulées une fois sur deux , le programme n'est pas respecté et surtout triste; aucune ambiance, nous étions au Riu en 2013, c'était autre chose, ma femme faisait de l'aqua gym tous les jours, grosse ambiance: le jour et la nuit !
-Autre gros point d'agacement : le " Time Share " ; les concierges qui sont cencées s'occuper de vous, notamment de reserver les restaus ( tous les jours car les resas se font au jour le jour .. ) sont interessées ( elles touchent une prime ) si elles vous inscrivent à une presentation au club Melia, encore une fois beaucoup trop pushy !
Conseil dire NON des le depart !
Conclusion: grosse deception, nous ne retournerons pas dans cet hotel que je déconseille, je conseille plutôt le Riu ou le Barcelo.

reviews.author: piniola
reviews.title: El paradisus sumamente "tropical" y engañoso
reviews.text: Somos socios del club Meliá , pagamos una membresía de varios de miles de dólares , en un viaje anterior donde los cazadores de clientes o vendedores de resort te acosan sin descanso con su discurso habitual, te prometen villas y Castillas , entre todos los beneficios que tienes dejan claro que por comprar en este lugar la membresía esta siempre será algo así como tu "casa matriz" donde disfrutaras de lo mejor de este hotel. Pues decidimos en octubre del año pasado (2014) venir a descansar una semana en estas fechas (finales de mayo 2015). Supuestamente lo que nos correspondía era alojar en lo que llaman  "la reserva" , a pesar de la anticipación con que hicimos nuestra solicitud fue imposible conseguir disponibilidad. Al llegar nos dieron habitaciones normales del hotel disfrutando todas las áreas  por el derecho que nos correspondía , sin embargo, la atención fue bastante tropical y deficiente , el personal es muy amable y sonriente , muy bailarines y cariñosos pero ineficientes, si bien tenemos claro que estamos en "república Dominicana" los servicios deberían tener la excelencia de un Meliá de esta categoría y no ser tan variables , un día ponían toallas en la habitación a primera hora al otro día se les olvidaba, un día ponían café , al otro día no , un día reponían los amenities al otro día no, un día hacían la habitación por las mañanas otro día llegaban cuando uno ya estaba regresando de la playa y debíamos esperar que terminarán con nosotros dentro. A pesar de que se esforzaron en darnos un trato preferencial , incluso regalándonos un masaje en el spa , lo cierto es que cuando uno compra una membresía hay que exigir que respeten el tipo de habitación que a uno le corresponde , esto ya que por mas que te den el derecho a disfrutar de todas las áreas del hotel incluso las áreas de "la reserva" la atención no es la misma. Por otra parte es muy ordinario el sistema que tienen con las bebidas alcohólicas , los camareros tienen escondidas las bebidas de mejor calidad y pareciera que deben consultar antes de servirla esto en el área de la playa de "la reserva" , como todo está incluido se cuidan de que lo "incluido" sea de la peor categoría . La diferencia entre el bar de "la reserva " y el resto del hotel es abismal , en palabras simples en "la reserva " son bebidas alcohólicas premium y en el resto es pura bebida alcohólica de quinta categoría. Por ultimo nos convencieron de ir a una supuesta reunión con un "representante" del club Meliá para supuestamente "explicarnos nuestros derechos y ayudarnos a disfrutar mejor nuestra membresía " , nos atendió un vendedor que nos dio una charla típica de convencernos de que lo mejor que nos había pasado era estar fuera de "la reserva" más cerca de la playa, además nos indicó que por el flujo de gente para que nos dieran la habitación de la reserva teníamos que hacer la solicitud prácticamente con UN AÑO de anticipación , esto mientras hacía dibujos y gráficos en un papel cual profesor de primaria , al final su cometido no era otro que ofrecer vendernos otra membresía a lo cual como es evidente respondimos que no estábamos interesados . Como recomendación es un hotel muy lindo, los restaurantes son buenos , hay gran variedad pero hay que estar claros en que si vas a pagar altas sumas de dinero por la membresía no todo lo que brilla es oro y tienen una letra pequeña que no te informan al momento de sacarte el dinero.

reviews.author: Katie H
reviews.title: What a disappointment :(
reviews.text:
We just spent 4 days at Palma Real at the first half of our trip this past week. We were attending a wedding at the Iberostar Grand Bavaro and decided that it was too expensive to stay there the entire time. So we booked half of our trip at Palma Real and half at Iberostar. What a mistake!

There were a few things we liked about Paradisus Palma Real- mostly the beverage service and beautiful room. Even though we booked a cheap room, it was Huge and very nice! The beverage service was also great as there were several bars serving interesting and unique cocktails from very friendly and helpful staff. Unfortunately that is all that I can say good things about.

The food at this resort was some of the worst food I've ever had. We visited all of the ala carte restaurants and every night we were so disappointed that we left the restaurant and went to the buffet just to find something we might tolerate so we didn't end up starving. Even the buffet was very impressive looking, but 95% of the items on the buffet were overcooked, dry and horribly under seasoned!

We wondered if all resorts had food this bad but when we switched to the Iberostar it was a whole different thing! Food at Iberostar was fantastic and we were so sad that we went to Palma Real first.

Additionally the pool was about 50% useless with no chairs around it at all, and no shade anywhere to be found. So the 50% that did have cover and a bar and seating around it was very busy and we could never find a chair to use the entire time. The Iberostar definitely did not have this issue!

The beach was so covered in seaweed that if they bothered to clean it up, you'd never know it, and the water was so full of it that you couldn't even enjoy swimming, let alone the sand. At the Iberostar Grand, it was just a little further down the same beach but little to no seaweed at all! Not on the beach or in the water. That was a huge difference.

We would definitely not return.

reviews.author: johnmichaels776
reviews.title: Front desk is a nightmare
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, the food and ambience is great but the people at front desk are a nightmare to deal with.  They can't never help you no matter how small the problem is and they don't seem to care about how much of your time they waste any time you need them for something. The attitude is poor and there is no desire on their part to help you whatsoever.  They should train the people at front desk the same way the train the restaurants staff.

reviews.author: Katerina_CA
reviews.title: Don't stay here
reviews.text:
We've only just checked in today and I am so disappointed that I would like to warn other families - do not stay here if you're used to high end all inclusive resorts. The Reserve is supposed to be the exclusive part of the resort yet it is the furthest from the beach. The trolley that takes you there is a bumpy, nauseating experience. If you've driven a Jeep on Hana highway in Hawaii you get the idea. 
Dining so far has been extremely disappointing. I am enclosing a photo of my mother's salad with disgusting broccoli that is so old that it has gone completely brown.  I ordered a chicken Ceaser salad and the waiter brought a salad with no chicken saying that they ran out. Just unbelievable. 
The rooms are large and nice but given that the Reserve is far from the water you get no view to speak of. Finally when we showed up at the pool there was no pool boy in sight or any way to get service. We actually had to call our concierge who was nice enough to come to the pool and bring a few towels. I am beyond disappointed.

reviews.author: pjames59
reviews.title: Reserve did not live up to expectations
reviews.text: While the resort was nice overall and the beach access wonderful, it seemed like every time we turned around we were asked to take a time share tour or were paying extra for food and beverage. Will not go back.

reviews.author: Mane S
reviews.title: Gran Decepción, nunca más volveremos
reviews.text:
2 días antes de irnos nos "desaparecieron" 1300 dólares de la caja fuerte.
Nos hospedamos en el Paradisus Palma Real.

Tanto el mayordomo como la gente de limpieza tienen la obligación de informar cuando la caja está abierta y no lo hicieron.
No solo que no nos dieron una solución sino que nos revisaron las valijas, desconfiando de nuestra palabra.

NO RECOMIENDO EN ABSOLUTO ESTE HOTEL. Todo muy lindo pero un robo en semejante hotel NO puede ocurrir. Pésima experiencia.

reviews.author: Jon K
reviews.title: Mal desde el principio / Wrong from the beginning!
reviews.text:
Algunas recomendaciones suenan espectaculares para este hotel, sin embargo debí haber escuchado a mis instintos. En el Meliá Caribe una situación con las toallas me dejó ver cómo los trabajadores hablan de los clientes a sus espaldas. Falta de profesionalismo que lo vi porque hablo español. Igual en Mx, tabajadores que hacen lo que quieren y no tratan al cliente como se merece… Si no se les da propina! 
En esta ocasión, reservamos para el Reserva Punta Cana. Dos íbamos desde USA y otra desde otro país. 4 días antes, nos cambiaron la reserva. Una Sra Sánches dijo que habían ocupado el hotel de más, así que  nos daban un 'upgrade' al Palma Real (no el Reserve!). Le solicitamos que NO nos cambiaran la reserva, que nos respetaran la reserva inicial. Habíamos buscado lo que era mejor para mi familia que incluía un niño y una sra de edad. NUNCA nos dio ninguna respuesta. Sólo decía que estaba esperando a que los gerentes decidieran. Hicimos la reserva en enero, y en abril nos la cambiaron a última hora! Totalmente insultante y más cuando lo presentaban como un 'upgrade' cuando realmente no lo era.
En miras de disfrutar las vacaciones, decidimos seguir con nuestros planes. Mi esposo quería reservar en otro hotel, pero are muy encima. Llegamos al hotel y a mi mamá le iban  cobrar más- 40 minutos para solucionar eso.  Luego cada día teníamos que esperar 20 minutos para poder reservar para un restaurante cada noche (situación que se puede evitar si se tiene un concierge, como hubiera pasado con mi reserva inicial); la habitación súper lejos de la piscina (como no lo era en el Reserve - reserva inicial). Minibar con solo sodas y cerveza.
En Mexico nos preparaban la tina con burbujas, balloons, etc. Acá no nos dejaban los saludos.
Definitivamente, pésimo! Falta de coordinación, de organización! Es el primer sitio en el que veo que cuando venden más habitaciones los que pagan son los clientes. Hasta que encontré el por qué! Los que reservan a última hora pagan más! Asi que los que pagamos antes, con meses en anticipación, nos mandan a las habitaciones de tarifas más bajas! 
Tengo snapshots para demostrar que cuando nos dijeron que el hotel estaba 'overbooked' (ya habiendo reservado), todavía había habitaciones disponibles. Nunca Mas!

reviews.author: Donnapcdr
reviews.title: Shocking Disappointment...
reviews.text: We have always wanted to stay at a Paradisus over the last 15 years of going to Punta Cana and have stayed at many properties there. I had heard their reputation was to be one of the best hotels there. This is not what we experienced. We had a very stressful and aggravating week due to many intolerable problems. Botched reservation on their part having no Royal Service available as was told to us, broken furniture so bad it had to be replaced, blown power in the room, no wifi was working, hours spent calling around to try to find someone to make reservations as our concierge was no where to be found, amenities through the MY Time package were never delivered, mosquitoes so bad we had to move to another room on the third floor with no elevator, $700.00 extra spent to get Royal Service "access" to amenities only to have all of our requests ignored to get the items they advertise and are not even aware of. Also minibar was only stocked twice the whole week unless we called and requested.  Perhaps this was a fluke in comparison to the other reviews but it was absolutely awful from a customer service perspective. I do not expect a 5 star hotel, especially at such a high pricepoint, to blame their reservation mistakes on my travel agent and basically say "hey, this is a business" so basically deal with it, as Marco had told me, unreal !  They were not willing to accept any responsibility for ignoring any and all requests prior to getting there.They were absolutely not interested in offering any concessions whatsoever in light of all of this. Most luxury hotels would at least offer an upgrade or something. I was pretty shocked. We are waiting to hear from the hotel and hoping that they will be reasonable and offer us a fair settlement on our stay. So far we have received a very unfair one.  I will review further when we hear something more without going into detail but just to say whether they dealt with us fairly. I will say that the grounds are very beautiful, as most bavarro hotels are, and the food is quite good, although very tightly rationed. We have stayed at Bavarro hotels with fewer stars for less money who showed much, much, more concern for their customers. So now let us see if this is true.

reviews.author: Mariana V
reviews.title: Falta de comunicação
reviews.text: Havíamos reservado o hotel do dia 17 a 21/04, no entanto chegaríamos apenas no dia 18 às 7hs da manhã. Entramos em contato com antecedência com o Hotel para avisar do late check in e pagamos a diária do dia 17. Ao chegarmos ao hotel, haviam dado NO SHOW e não havia quarto disponível! Ficamos até as 15hs aguardando um quarto disponibilizar. Então sabendo que chegaríamos tarde e que já havíamos pago a diária do quarto, passaram para outros hospedes. Na verdade nós perdemos uma diária por essa falta de cuidado e comunicação entre os funcionários que não cumpriram o que haviam acordado via email conosco. Além disso, nesse período de espera de quarto não nos deram as pulseiras de acesso e fomos destratados pelos funcionários que não tinham como saber que eramos hóspedes. Considerando que ficamos apenas 3 noites, isso estragou 1/3 da nossa viagem. O Hotel é excelente, instalações e alimentação. Mas esse descuido é inaceitável pelo preço que pagamos em cada diária.

reviews.author: Monica M
reviews.title: Lower your expectations and you will only be slightly disappointed
reviews.text:
The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana is a nice looking resort with a beautiful beach, but has very poor service and mostly mediocre food and experiences.  We went with a group of 11 (3 families with children 11-14)

Before you go:  Don’t bother calling as they will most likely hang up on you or leave you on hold for a long time (this was not only our experience but I spoke to others at the resort).  Making reservations ahead of time does not work as we sent them a month before and none of them were made.  The only thing that was complete ahead of time was an airport pick up as that was done online.  Also, don’t bother trying to get rooms next to each other ahead of time, as that will also not happen.  Needless to say, the check in took two hours because none of the above was complete ahead of time and we were unable to get a reservation at any of the restaurants on our first night, which of course was one of our friend’s birthdays.

Service:  The worst part about the trip and the resort was the service.  When you go to many islands, the staff is happy to have you there, tries to solve problems and is friendly in general.  I would say that this resort had none of those traits.  From a horrible check in that took two hours for all of the wrong reasons, to the many issues that arose because all of the requests up front weren’t honored to just many bad interactions, this is an all time low service experience. Service people were not trained well for a higher end resort as most do not make eye contact and with the exemption of one concierge, no one attempts to solve problems.   We paid extra for the concierge (Elvis) and the only thing we really had him do was make reservations for the week, which as I said before were already submitted but not honored.  He confirmed reservations for Sunday-Wednesday as Saturday ended up being the below mediocre buffet, but couldn’t confirm Thursday and Friday for some weird reason.  We asked everyday about those days and got- “working on it” all the way up to Thursday at 6:15 when he wasn’t around.  I called and found out it was at 7 when requested for 8:30 and we wouldn’t be ready.  So, I had to call around attempted to talk with management, who was in a meeting and another concierge ended up getting us food at that restaurant, but never a call back or check in from the management about the issue.  In the meantime, I had to make my own reservation for Friday because I couldn’t trust Elvis.  Other things were no towels available after 6PM at the pool and rude answers as to why, the pool closes at 7PM, the swim up bar is the worst set up as one person covers up and down and is never available…and it closes at 5.  Our friends had issues with their sink and toilet on day one and it was never fixed, although asked about several times.    We asked for blankets, never got them- more towels- never came- more water- only came once at 2AM.  

The rooms and grounds:  The rooms are ok- but asked for a king and got two full beds. We would've switched, but we spent 2 hours trying to get all of our groups rooms together and didn't want to ruin that. The tile floors combined with wood chairs made for early mornings as our upstairs neighbors dragged them at 7am everyday and it sounded like a bad trombone player waking you every morning.  There are some drinks in the fridge but it's limited and there are only 4 waters in the room for the day- so bring some back from a bar.  The pull out worked fine for one of our children.  The grounds are very nice, but many people talked about how far away the beach is which was inconvenient but great exercise.  The activities for the kids were very good as there was a rock climbing wall and trampoline that was well supervised.  Parents just needed to sign the kids up and then could leave the kids to it.  The Paradisus main hotel I thought was a lot nicer looking than the Reserve and I didn’t think anything was worth the extra for the Reserve.  Also, most of the restaurants and nightly activities were at the main hotel.  The gym was small with old equipment, but did offer classes, which I thought was a nice touch.  Wifi coverage of the grounds is really bad.  It is either slow or non-existent in most areas. Towels- only 4 per room and as many times as we called for more, no one ever comes. It's cold and we asked for blankets several nights, but alas none came. It actually became a joke by the end as I called at 8am the day we left for towels as we had only 1 and we left the room at 9 and of course, they are consistent as no one came!  

The Pools: The pool area was very good at all locations with plenty of beds, covered and open, tile loungers in the pool and the water temp was refreshing.  The only problem was that the pool closes at 7PM and there are no towels available after 6- and when you ask, you are ignored or told no towels.  Also, the swim up bar at the Reserve was a more like a bartender stair master as the same guy was covering upstairs and down so was rarely there. 

Golf:  Free golf was ok but carts were $65 per person, which is crazy.

Nightlife:  Nightlife is non-existent. Beach party on Saturday and Tuesday is fun, but It ends at 11pm. Nightclub and live music did not have a lot of people in them and they play 80% Latin music.   In fairness, we did not attend any of the shows as my group likes to dance and have a good time and stay out late.

The Food: All of the buffets are not very good- very small and not a big selection. They did a good job with a lot of fruit and there were grill options, but most of the prepared options were over salted or sauced.  Breakfast buffet was ok- but if you can get a warm fried doughnut, go for it as it is delicious. If you do go, order items from the grill.  Fish was good on the grill- you can get a whitefish and tuna in edition to beef and chicken.  Breakfast closes at 11am and lunch doesn't start until 12:30. The biggest hunger gap is between 3:30 when lunch ends  and 6:30 when dinner begins. Eat at Mole for lunch as its good sit down Mexican. The Grill was not very good steakhouse- poor cuts and they seem to overcook everything.  Aqua was ok. The appetizers were good, but the entrees were not great; don't get the cod- very hard and overlooked. Vento was very good italian; good seafood (tuna was excellent) good pasta. Bana was a standard habachi place- good, but not great. Fuego was our favorite- tuna appetizers were awesome, service was outstanding as they were very attentive and for dessert they just brought everything out. One call out is that coffee at the resort dinners was outstanding; dark and delicious and most of the desserts were pretty good. 

The beach:  The sand was amazing, the water fantastic, but the vendors along beach are annoying.  Same ones come by a lot and take a while to go away. It's bad cigars, bags and sunglasses and some other random ones. 
Service at the beach on the Reserve beach was poor. If only the waiters came by as often as the vendors!  We tipped $20 to keep them coming and that did nothing. We even tried consistent $5 tips and that did nothing. We ended up going to the bar shack to order most of our drinks. 
The Ocean: Sea life is relatively non-existent. Along the shore there is absolutely none as there are a fair amount of waves, which was cool for body surfing. When we went on an excursion, there were very limited fish along the coral and even when we went deeper with snuba. 

Checkout: was weird as they don't automatically charge your card as it's not on file and they don't automatically give you the voucher for the airport shuttle- as per everything else, you need to get it yourself. Then the shuttle is not directly to the airport, as you need to stop at other hotels first. 

Best parts of the vacation were the weather which was the best I've ever had- low 80s ad sunny with 20 minutes of rain the whole time. The breeze at night was amazing as it carried away any frustration from the day's poor service. The beach was beautiful sand, loungers, beds, straw umbrellas and great water and waves. The resort itself is beautiful, although I find the main hotel much more impressive than the Reserve.

reviews.author: Arthur Y
reviews.title: Soaked our bed
reviews.text: Staff soaked our bed because, we can only assume that they thought they got a poor review over our Club Melia experience.  We were told that the presentation would only take 90 minutes over breakfast.  We were very disappointed that we wasted 2 hours and 30 minutes of our vacation away from our children.  Then they called us caustic because we told them we were not interest and that it didn't make financial sense.  We were never even shown a brochure.  Nothing but numbers written on a white sheet of paper.  Very unprofessional.

reviews.author: Peggy Ann C
reviews.title: Disappointed and frustrated
reviews.text: Rerserve rooms were too far from the beach very inconvenient. For the price they should be on the beach. We did not have the Family concierge so we could not get any beach or pool cabanas. We had to wait until 10 and by then they were all taken. Personal concierge said she would check on a cabana for us each day and did not get back to us. They asked our dinner choices first day of checkin for the entire stay. I don't know why because dinner reservations can only be made day of and then we could not get the times we wanted even though we were requesting first thing each morning. Shuttles for dinner took a very long time to get. Waited over 30 minutes during "rush" hour. When paying over $850/nt would expect a little more attention to details and customer expectations. .My son wanted to play basketball. The full size court is on the far end of the property near the tennis courts but they don't have a basketball there, you have to go to the beach which is about a 25 min walk from there. There is a nice hoop on the beach but the basketballs are in the worst condition, threads, seams pulled apart, lumpy. Seriously, this property can't invest in a couple of $20 basketballs???  Would not return to this property.

reviews.author: Hector T
reviews.title: Bonitas Comida, debe Mejorar Limpieza
reviews.text:
Llegue a las 12:00pm al Hotel. La habitación fué entregada a las 4:10, la misma no era cama King, solicitamos el cambio y a las 4:30 nos entregan la habitación 2009 con cama matrimonial, el polvo y la humedad que tenía era increíble. Nos acercamos a recepción y  nuevamente nos pusieron a esperar. A las 5:20pm nos asignaron una habitación similar a la reservada. La Encargada de Host Adriana manejó el caso. Estoy muy inconforme con el trato recibido. El hotel no está preparado para estas fechas de mucho tránsito de huésped. No obstante la comida hasta el momento ha sido excepcional. 

Para una persona mínimamente asmática no recomiendo la higiene del hotel. Mi pareja que no lo es no lo soportaba. Los servicios de Salud son muy caros por esta zona y si viene de vacaciones es algo que debe de sopesar.

reviews.author: David M
reviews.title: Not a premium experience...of good
reviews.text:
We are currently vacationing at Paradisus Punta Cana and are only hours into a really bad start. Check in process was horrible. 2 hours to check in and fill out paperwork, almost every part was a complete cluster. We called to make reservations ahead of time 3 times and after getting hung up on twice, the third was confirmed by Ignatio and we sent emails to confirm and never received anything back. Sure enough none of the reservations were made and the only dinner reservation at any restaurant was for 6:45 and it was our friends birthday.  We also called and confirmed that the the families coming would all be in the same area- also didn't happen. After much discussion we got us close together.  

The beach is nice, but like everyone says, it's rather far away. The really bad part is there is no food at the beach and no one sets up an area for you which would be expected in the Reserve.  They allow people to come up and down the beach selling cigars, bags, etc and they keep coming. 

High end alcohol is not included in any package, which we thought would be as we picked the premium area- The Reserve. 

I hope it gets better.

reviews.author: E D
reviews.title: It's OK at best.
reviews.text:
First let me say that this place is beautiful. It definitely catches you off guard when you first get here. We had waited three hours in an insane customs line, then a wild bus ride (only about 20 min from airport), so we were so happy to arrive. The royal service lounge greeted us with mimosas and a snack, which was welcomed since we hadn't eaten for many hours. 
Things went down from from there. It definitely took us a little bit to figure things out. The butler who showed us to our room was not our permanent butler, so that was confusing. Be prepared for a serious language barrier. You get a phone to call your butler, but we never used it. We would have much preferred if texting was an option, and it always seemed like the butler was surprising you with questions just as you sat down. Once we figured out the royal service beach and pool, we were glad they had much better loungers.  We felt bad that the other guests got those crappy chairs! Leo at the royal service pool bar was very nice and knew us by name shortly after we arrived. One thing I didn't like was that there was no cocktail menu. I found myself asking for ingredients they didn't have and trying to dream up different cocktails because they had no suggestions. The second to last day our butler finally talked to the pool concierge so we could get a decent seat on the beach. We were wondering how they were all taken so early. 
The breakfast buffet is OK, but be prepared that it's the same every day. The service at the buffet is shotty at best and again big language barrier issues. We wished the whole trip that they had better maps and explanations of the food and restaurants. No where did it tell you what to expect at any of the food places. Our butler did make us reservations for our whole trip and we found that helpful. The food for dinner is not good. I mean definitely not good. The palazzo special royal service place messed up fettuccini with red sauce. The rolls were hard as a rock. Gross. And they give you a wine list with prices on it because wine apparently is not included!?  The Mexican place was just OK (margaritas bad) and hibachi was OK, but no yum yum sauce. The Mediterranean place was beyond gross except the white bread.  My sister ordered grouper and it was beyond disgusting. We did do the Passion extra charge place and it was quite delicious. Let me say, I had the craps on and off the whole trip and my sister threw up once. 
The spa was also just OK. I've definitely been to better. Be prepared that they are not discrete and will see you butt naked several times and rub pretty much everywhere. The pedicure woman filed both our feet RAW.  Oh yes and booking the spa was no easy task. We first had a Spanish menu, then got an English menu that was apparently too old. Our butler couldn't even figure out how to book our services. We finally had to just go there and try to book ourselves. Be prepared for a wild golf cart ride to get there. 
The room was nothing special. They pushed two full size beds together even though we had requested two beds separate and the headboards were clearly for two beds. The sheets were all messed up because no sheet was big enough for this makeshift bed. My sister was mummified one night by the bottom sheet cluster. Basically limited English TV and Internet barely works. I mean bad internet. BAD!!!!!!!  So frustrated by the time we left. The shower was only sometimes hot. And the towels were rough. The sheets also needed replaced, very scratchy. We got a pillow menu and requested different pillows several times with no success.  It seems like there is constantly someone knocking at the door saying something to you that you absolutely have no chance of understanding. My sister called one night to ask for tissues...they showed up with two rolls of toilet paper and some trash bags. We had a garden view room. By this they mean you face a street with trucks and gas golf carts driving by at all hours. 
I know we have to keep in mind that this is basically third world. Next time we'll visit an American or European Caribbean island.

reviews.author: newtonSA
reviews.title: Punta Canta Palma Real
reviews.text: If you like Carnival Cruises then this is the hotel for you to stay at in Punta Cana. It was exhausting at times from check in to check out, I found everything to be overly complicated.The service was only good after leaving healthy tips.

reviews.author: Lkrenger
reviews.title: No "Royal Service" Here!
reviews.text:
Don't get me wrong this is a beautiful resort and the staff was friendly and grounds pristine... But they were not accommodating at all. We were traveling with a large group for Spring Break - 29 adults and 24 kids. We were encouraged to upgrade to "Royal Service" when we arrived and, for an additional $50 per person, we all did.  This supposedly gave us access to the Royal Service facilities and premium liquor/wine and restaurants. There was a private pool and beach area but true premium liquor and wine was additional. The special restaurant was also an additional charge of $70 per person. When we tried to make a reservation for the 29 adults, we were told the max was 24, even if we agreed to be sat at multiple tables, so we were never able to all eat together. We did have a nice beach party where they set up tables, a buffet and bar and decorated it beautifully. This was $40 extra per person but given the set-up that was more reasonable. At one point, the adults were all in the "Royal Service" lounge
and when several people ordered white wine we were told "No, not serving white
wine tonight, just red". They had served white wine the night before and there was
white wine at every other bar. One of the guests went and got all the people a glass who wanted one. We were there for one glass of wine before our $70 dinner and were just told "nope, only red wine?!"  They just were never able to fill any requests. We spent a lot of money and still felt like they were charging us at every turn. Despite us paying all the upcharges, they still weren't accommodating of any kind of request. Again, it was beautiful and pristine but never again and certainly not with any kind of large group like a wedding.

reviews.author: Ticoboricua
reviews.title: good property , terrible customer service, salty food,
reviews.text:
property was very nice.  bed matress uncomfortable. there is a switch in room that turns on and off the wifi router. we didn't know that so we were without internet for 3 days as we turned off unknowingly. called a few times and on finally on third day someone at front desk told us to check for switch. other people didn't know this solution at first.  food was average.  found the room service food to be tastier. but overall food was on the salty side to my liking.  i thought it was that they cook there locally salty but we moved to the paradisuss palma real for second half of trip and food was substantially tastier at the other place.  

the walls between bedrooms are paper thin, so you can hear everything from next door neighbour. so can get very loud if you have neighbours that sleep late....

main problem is that i left 2 pairs of noise cancelling headphones. i'm fairly certain that i left it behind there. called a number of times to lost and found which is their guest services department and they didn't care to call me back.  i called a number of times and each time they said they would check and never heard back from them.  my fault for leaving stuff behind but would have been nice if they checked and called me back.  i gave up on them.

reviews.author: TheKu
reviews.title: Awful expierience.......
reviews.text: Beautiful property, food service has major issues. I too was part of a 400 person event at this hotel, not my first Dominican trip, actually this was my fourth time visiting punta cana. The previous review that was posted quoted numbers of 100 out of 400 becoming ill........ I think that number is low. Every other person you spoke with had experienced some degree of stomach issue, my first hand knowledge is that i traveled with a party of four, we were all sick, some longer than others, we stayed seven days, six nights, my daughter in law was down five out of the seven days, she and my son are still sick after returning home. This is not a big issue to a lot of people, but when you spend the kind of money this resort charges you do not expect to have to deal with this sort of thing. What good does a fantastic looking buffet or an amazing restaurant menu do for you when the only thing you trust is rice, bread, and bottled water, so as you can keep something down or controlling its exit, not fun.  Not fun when you have four school aged children at home, who you pack for, who you arrange for them to be watched by family, who then takes them to all activities, etc, while you are gone, so you can have some much deserved time away, time you plan for, time you look so much forward to, not to spend it in your room on or around a toilet..... You miss group activities because you never know how close the nearest bathroom would be. Yes it was plain awful. I have traveled all over the Caribbean, through out Mexico, South America, and as i said above punta cana three times previously, always you have a few people who get ill, but this is not an exaggeration of the number of travelers who were sick. I will not go into standing in four inches of water everytime i took a shower for it did not drain, will not go into after returning in the middle of the afternoon from a walk, chasing a two inch water roach around the bathroom until i caught it, will not talk about the mini bar service, absolutely no liquor at all, asked for it on monday, asked again on tuesday, never did show up. They give you two presidente beers everyday, keep in mind there are two people in the room..... they will bring you two more if you call for more, if you get up to a quantity of six in one day, and call again, ( because you have nothing else to do, your wife has been laying in bed all day sick)  they tell you that you have had enough for one day and can not bring you anymore. All inclusive?, i think not unless, you are talking about the stomach issues you will have. I do not mean to trash this place, the company that we traveled with, we have traveled with for years, the tour group that they use are very professional, and very much on top of their game, they are both good companies and do their homework. Was no way they could have seen this coming. The property was magnificent, the staff was very friendly, maid service was awesome, but they need to address just what exactly is making all of these people sick, at this point in time i would never stay here again, or recommend it to anyone. The only reason i did not give this a zero rating was because the property, the rooms, the beach were all very beautiful, but you can not stay here seven days and not eat or drink.

reviews.author: Nicole S
reviews.title: From bad to worse
reviews.text:
I apologize, this is a little long but it's with good reason.  I was recently at the Paradisus Palma Real for one of my best friend's wedding.  Our flight got in a little late and since I didn't want to miss any of the wedding festivities already in play we darted through the airport, got to our airport transfer desk where they took all of my to and from vouchers and told us to show up the next morning of our VACATION at 9 am for a “meeting” in the lobby in order to get our return trip sorted out.  Yeah, we didn’t go because they have an office onsite that is staffed for that.  But we heard from others it was a timeshare/excursion sales pitch.  We slept through it and had no issues getting our transfer home.  Such a waste of time.  We were then taken to a minivan then there was some sort of confusion while the drivers argued among themselves.  I was told we were waiting for someone I don’t know  who...and waiting....and waiting.  After about 15 minutes I stuck my head out of the van and asked that we go, this was supposed to be a private ride.  The drivers then made us get out and move to another van.  Shouldn't have been a big deal, right?  This was only the beginning of the confusion that would continue to plague our stay.  

We got to the Paradisus and immediately were greeted by a woman who started to tell us that our room might not be ready (great first impression) and tried to give away our luggage to the bellmen.  I told everyone who would listen that a) it was after 6 pm and check in was at 3, there should be a room for us, we had confirmed, b) I wanted to keep my luggage with me and c) we needed a room ASAP to change and get to a wedding related event.  In retrospect, being extremely vocal about it was the only thing that saved us hours of waiting and lots of confusion. I held onto my luggage for dear life and we were taken to the check in desk where they started to try to tell us that they didn’t have a room and then to sell us an upgraded room.  When I protested that I didn’t really care and needed to go (it’s been well over an hour since we touched down and I’m beyond late at this point thanks to the minivan wait and trying to explain to a large host of people not to touch my luggage) he reluctantly gave us an upgraded room for free.  You would think this is a nice gesture but knowing what I know now, they shouldn’t have done it as it caused massive confusion for other guests.  They again tried to take our luggage and I literally had to just walk off.  The reason they do this is, they hold your luggage hostage while they pile you into a golf cart, tote you around the property and try to sell you stuff.  This was not my first time at this rodeo.  

We got to our room and it was nice but as soon as I touched the bathroom door, it came off the hinges, there were signs of poor construction and the AC sounded like a leaf blower.  We couldn’t run it during the night and had to just leave the fan on to circulate the air in order to sleep.  Gorgeous view or not sometimes you just need a quiet clean room.  The rest of the visit for us was plagued with gross food (I had an upset tummy from everything except the room service pizza I got) power outages and lack of warm water which was especially rough when trying to shower to get ready for the wedding.  On the last night I finally called and begged them to come and bring us some minibar provisions ie water, something that was supposed to be refilled daily but never was.    Our other party guests were plagued with constant room changes (they were upgraded at first and then told to move to a non-renovated room later), dirty rooms, sinks and showers clogged, roaches in their rooms and the spa, transfer issues for pick up ie no one was there to pick them up and drop off, unresponsive staff, provided a room that was already given to someone else, lack of beds, stolen items, broken safes, and a couple was sent to stay at the resort next door instead of with us, etc.  The list goes on and on.  

All of that to say the trip was only positive because my beautiful friend got married and we were among a great group of people.  However, I have never been to a more distasteful hotel.  The staff and administration of this resort was just ridiculously unorganized and thought we were insane for wanting them to get things right.  The matron of honor spent her entire vacation trying to solve issues and begging for senior leadership attention to our issues.  Let’s just say, none of us will be back.

reviews.author: DaveThornbury
reviews.title: Service nightmare in the Caribbean
reviews.text:
My wife and I along with two other couples decided to spend a week at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. Our stay was from February 14-21, rooms 2421, 2422 and 2423.
 
The nightmare begins upon check in which took almost two hours. Our friends ended up getting our suite (which got corrected the following day). We weren’t given any orientation of the property just a lousy map and told our concierge could book our dinner reservations, reserve cabanas for us and so on.
 
We go to our room and then immediately head to our concierge to have her book dinner reservations for us since it’s Valentines Day. She tells us our concierge is not here and she handles the other half of our building. It’s now 5:30 and she finally says it really doesn’t matter because dinner reservations needed to be made by 5 and our only choice now is the buffet. Not a happy camper so we head to the bar.
 
The following morning our wives go to make dinner reservations for the week. They are first told you have to make them day-by-day and had to give a time range. They requested between 7 and 8:30 but were told they had to make the range to 9. They explain 9 is too late for the 6 of us. They check back at 5 p.m. and nothing had been booked at that point and was told to check back in an hour or so. Finally get all our reservations and everyone was at 9 p.m. This took several days to correct and yet we still had a few at 9 and couldn’t get into some.
 
Our concierge was rarely there and when she was she wasn’t helpful at all. We tried to reserve a cabana at the pool or the beach and were told only families could reserve them. When we explained that upon check in we were told that she could reserve them for us she stated that wrong. We are now all a little frosted in the 80-degree weather.
 
Now understand the Reserve is the most expensive part of the resort so we expected superior service. One of the couples with us switched from Paradisus luxury junior suite with Royal Service to the Reserve to be near us at an increase of three thousand dollars. Where they originally had booked they would have been able to reserve cabanas and so much more.
 
Over the next several days we had nightmare after nightmare with service at the various restaurants. They would forget our drinks orders, forget the wine we ordered, forget wine glasses, forget to open the wine, and this includes one of the restaurants that has an upcharge to eat at. It gets worse, we showed up for a 7 p.m. dinner reservation with the reservation card in hand. Remember it took us days to correct all the 9 p.m. seating’s we were booked. The receptionist said they didn’t have us at 7 but at 9 and come back then. We again showed her the reservation card and she really didn’t care. We asked for a manager whom came and started with the same crap and then finally sat us. We asked to speak with the general manager of the resort (which we had asked on several occasion to no avail). The night manager of the resort did come and visit, we explain all our problems and she stated she’d get them all correct (never happened).
 
The next evening we had reservations at the Grill at 8:30 not where we had wanted to go but they could not move up our 9 p.m. reservation at our first choice (booked 5 days earlier). The Grill is a crossed between a restaurant and a buffet. After waiting for over a half hour and still not seated (and they couldn’t tell us when we would be seated) one of the guys in our party gave the hostess $20 to get us seated, final around 8:45 we got seated. Bare in mind our first choice our reservations were originally at 9.
 
Not all experiences were bad, some good restaurants in the mix but it was clear service overall was lacking, no one could ever give us a straight answer or the same answer through the resort.
 
Our last day there we discover there was many water activities included- sure would have been nice to know about them early on so we had a chance to used them.
 
Now for the good, the rooms are very nice and the resort property is amazing. If they can ever get service issues corrected we would consider returning but not now.

reviews.author: EPL711
reviews.title: DIRTY, HORRIBLE SERVICE, OVERBOOKED, DISASTER WEDDING
reviews.text:
My sister just had her destination wedding there on Saturday.  The officiant didn't say my sister or husband's name correctly, announced the wrong married name at the end.  The staff was drinking our alcohol while serving during the reception and then proceeded to eat the frosting off their cake and carve up slices for themselves.  WE WERE APPAULED!!!!

Our 70 guests had nothing but trouble.  Some people were upgraded, 2 hours waiting for check-in, wrong room catergories because they were overbooked.  The rooms are filthy and in poor condition.  TVs don't work, remotes don't work, door locks don't work, crust in the baths, no hot water, power outages daily, wifi doesn't work in most rooms, ROACHES in 2 of our guests' rooms and in the spa bathroom.  Torn and broken sofa, clogged sinks, clogged showers, mosquitos in the room so we had to wear bug spray to sleep.  Rooms weren't cleaned, double booked, air conditioning not working.  Minibar not stocked.  DRAMA DRAMA DRAMA!!  An unless you are shouting and having a melt down they don't care.  They moved several of our guests out of their rooms during their stay because the happened to get upgraded and then took it away.  

CAUTION:  There are 2 parts to the HOTEL.  1= OLD DIRTY AWFUL!  2= RENOVATED rooms in the FAMILY CONCIERGE portion above the main kitchen.  Rooms 6000s.  Anything else is BAD!!!  Buyer beware.  

All 70 guests are writing letters AND we have contacted Melia corporate in Miami and Spain about this situation.  Apparently the Melia Brand is very good and we see tons of great reviews, but this place is a horribly disorganized place.  I would only recommend if you book with ROYAL SERVICE and FAMILY CONCIERGE SERVICE and book in RENOVATED ROOMS.  You get access to butler and private beaches.  

Renovated rooms have flatscreen TVs, own wifi, marble floors, great ocean views, oval separate tub, very modern white decor.  

Old rooms have rear projection TVs, dusty and mildew rooms, mustard velour sofas.  It's not nice. 

The spa is fantastic and the main NAOS restaurant with buffet is good.  Room service menu is very limited.  Other restaurants...I wouldn't know.  Didn't get to try.  Totally booked on many nights and you likely need a reservation.  

Nightly entertainment was great.  Super fun.  70's disco, Michael Jackson show, Cirque Show.  Bravo here on entertainment!!!
